title: EMEA Corporate Social Responsibility Programme Manager
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

EMEA Corporate Social Responsibility Programme Manager

Role Purpose


Lead CSR, sustainability, community engagement and associate-focused initiatives across EMEA while contributing to a global team. Translate enterprise priorities into locally relevant, measurable action with strong regulatory awareness, cross-border thinking and disciplined execution.

Role Overview


Reporting to the SVP, Head of Corporate Social Responsibility and Associate Experience, this role may be based in Basildon, United Kingdom, or Dublin, Ireland.


EMEA is the primary focus, but the Programme Manager will also lead, support or contribute to global and cross-border initiatives, balancing enterprise consistency with local culture, business priorities and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities


Strategy and execution

  • Develop and deliver the EMEA CSR roadmap
  • Translate global priorities into clear regional programmes, policies, milestones, ownership and success measures

Global partnership

  • Represent EMEA on the global team
  • Contribute to enterprise initiatives
  • Share leading practices and improve consistency, scalability and impact across borders

Regulatory readiness

  • Monitor relevant EMEA sustainability, ESG and non-financial reporting developments
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, HR, Finance and other experts to assess implications and support readiness

Reporting and governance

  • Coordinate data collection, validation, controls and reporting for executive decision-making, disclosures and applicable requirements
  • Establish operating rhythms, KPIs and programme reviews

Community impact and volunteering

  • Manage strategic nonprofit and community relationships
  • Advance volunteering and community investment with appropriate due diligence and measurable outcomes

ERG enablement and associate engagement

  • Partner with ERG leaders and internal stakeholders to strengthen strategy, participation, ally engagement, governance and alignment with associate and business priorities

Sustainability

  • Support EMEA sustainability plans
  • Recommend improvements to regional practices, processes, tools and implementation

Stakeholder leadership and communications

  • Influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners without direct authority
  • Partner with Marketing, Brand and Communications on credible, evidence-based engagement and storytelling

Financial and operational discipline

  • Manage budgets, spend, vendors and partners
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and strengthen programme management, data and governance

Candidate Profile


A strategic, hands-on programme leader who combines EMEA expertise with a global mindset, strong execution discipline and the judgement to determine when regional adaptation or enterprise consistency is required.

What you will need to have


  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Five or more years of relevant experience in CSR, sustainability, ESG, community investment, associate engagement or inclusion, preferably in a multinational organisation
  • Experience designing, implementing and measuring multi-country or enterprise-wide programmes
  • Practical experience with EMEA sustainability, ESG or non-financial reporting requirements and evolving regulatory expectations
  • Working knowledge of frameworks and standards such as CSRD, ESRS, ISSB, GRI and the UN Sustainable Development Goals
  • Experience with data collection, reporting, KPIs, controls, programme governance, budgets and risk management
  • Ability to work across countries, cultures, functions and time zones in a complex, matrixed organisation
  • Excellent executive communication skills and proven ability to influence and lead without direct line-management authority

What Success Looks Like


  • EMEA programmes align with global strategy and regional requirements
  • Leaders have reliable insight into performance, risk and regulatory readiness
  • Initiatives have clear governance and measurable impact
  • Cross-border work is delivered with collaboration, accountability and disciplined execution

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Enterprise Architect

What does a successful Enterprise Architect do at Fiserv?


A successful Enterprise Architect at Fiserv serves as a hands-on technical advisor for complex transformation initiatives across enterprise-scale products, platforms, and services. This role helps engineering teams modernize legacy environments, define practical target-state architectures, and deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and cloud-ready solutions. The role also partners closely with product, engineering, architecture, and operations leaders to turn business priorities into clear design decisions, executable guidance, and successful delivery outcomes.

What you will do?


  • Serve as a hands-on architecture and engineering advisor for large-scale transformation initiatives across products, platforms, and services, helping maintain project continuity and support transition into business-as-usual operations aligned to the client go-live in September 2026.
  • Guide target-state architectures, modernization roadmaps, integration patterns, and reusable engineering standards while advising teams on simplifying complex legacy environments and enabling resilient, future-ready platforms.
  • Work directly with engineering teams to shape practical, secure, scalable, and maintainable solution designs across application, data, cloud, integration, API, microservices, and platform layers.
  • Review design options, technical trade-offs, dependencies, risks, and implementation approaches, while helping remove technical ambiguity, resolve design conflicts, and support teams through implementation challenges.
  • Partner with product, engineering, architecture, and operations leaders to align technology decisions with business priorities, while developing architecture artifacts, design specifications, integration models, infrastructure diagrams, and delivery guidance that teams can execute against.

What you must have?


  • 10+ years of experience in large-scale technology engineering, architecture, design, and implementation, including hands-on advisory experience in complex transformation programs.
  • 7+ years of experience with the Java technology stack, including Java/Spring Boot-based application architecture, APIs, and microservices.
  • Authorization to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship now or in the future, with the ability to work on-site 5 days per week.
    Bachelor’s degree in IT or equivalent relevant experience.

What would be nice to have?


  • 1+ year of experience with event streaming platforms and patterns, including Kafka-based event processing, pub/sub architecture, event-driven integration, and real-time data flows.
  • 1+ year of experience with mainframe operations, legacy modernization, or distributed platform migration.
  • 1+ years of experience with domain-driven design and cloud, data, and microservices architecture.

Salary Range

$146,000.00 - $244,800.00

title: Systems Engineer Internship - Summer 2027
description:
About FlightSafety International

FlightSafety International is the world’s premier professional aviation training company and supplier of flight simulators, visual systems and displays to commercial, government and military organizations. The company provides training for pilots, technicians and other aviation professionals from 167 countries and independent territories. FlightSafety operates the world’s largest fleet of advanced full-flight simulators and award-winning maintenance training at Learning Centers and training locations in the United States, Canada, France and the United Kingdom.

The Systems Engineer Intern will perform meaningful work alongside other talented professionals gaining insight to FlightSafety International’s culture and business philosophy.

This paid internship is a 10-week program that will begin June 1st and will conclude August 4th, 2027. 40 hours per week will be expected of each intern.

Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Understands the overall concept of the company, including the brand, customer, product goals, and all other aspects of service.
  • Rotates through our divisions of responsibility and provides ideas to grow and improve the business.
  • Accepts designated, business-focus projects to research, propose ideas and solutions, and present final project during the internship.
  • Engages with customers or clients and provides service and/or sales.
  • Provide suggestions to management for improving customer service and internal processes.
  • Learns and becomes proficient on internal software systems.

Minimum Education

  • Must currently be enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program, working towards a Bachelor's or Master's degree.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher at the time of application. Must be submitted on resume.

Minimum Experience

  • Fundamental knowledge of computer programs, techniques, and concepts for the area of application.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Strong work ethic, self-motivated, positive, personable, and ability to develop relationships.
  • Excellent critical thinking/problem solving skills.
  • Ability to handle confidential information.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

  • The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met and/or encountered by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

FlightSafety is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Vet/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Any offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of required compliance reviews, including verification that the candidate is not prohibited from employment under U.S. economic sanctions programs administered by the U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC).

This position may require access to export-controlled technology or services subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment consideration and any offer of employment are contingent upon the applicant’s ability to comply with these requirements, including qualifying as a “U.S. Person” under applicable regulations or otherwise eligible for export authorization within a timeframe consistent with business needs. A “U.S. Person” includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (holders of approved and unexpired green cards), and certain refugees or asylees with protected status under U.S. law.

This position may also require eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance for the duration of employment.

title: DfX Project Leader
description:
About the role:

The Full Automatic Coffee DfX Lead is accountable for delivering Design for Excellence (DfX) impact across the Full Automatic Coffee portfolio through redesign, re-specification and re-sourcing initiatives.
The role owns the DfX initiative portfolio and is responsible for converting opportunities into measurable business impact through cost reduction, margin improvement, quality enhancement and product competitiveness improvements.
Working across Product Management, R&D, Procurement, Quality and Operations, the DfX Lead drives execution, ensures robust governance and maintains a reliable view of delivery against targets.

The impact you’ll make:

Key responsibilities
Own DfX business impact
• Own the DfX initiative portfolio and annual savings targets.
• Deliver cost reduction and margin improvement commitments.
• Build and maintain a healthy DfX funnel through redesign, re-specification and re-sourcing opportunities.
• Identify risks early and implement recovery actions when targets are at risk.
Lead DfX governance
• Own and maintain the single source of truth for all DfX initiatives.
• Ensure every initiative has:
o Clear owner
o Financial impact
o Timing and critical path
o Dependencies
o Risk assessment
o Recovery plan
• Lead weekly reviews and monthly reporting.
• Ensure reporting accurately reflects actual project status.
Drive cross-functional execution
• Lead cross-functional teams across Product Management, R&D, Procurement, Quality and Operations.
• Drive actions to closure and remove roadblocks.
• Challenge delays and ensure accountability for delivery.
• Escalate issues proactively before business targets are impacted.
Support category strategy
• Identify opportunities to improve competitiveness, profitability and quality.
• Ensure DfX initiatives are integrated into product roadmaps and platform plans.
• Translate strategic ambitions into executable projects with measurable outcomes.
Provide management visibility
• Deliver accurate and timely reporting on DfX performance.
• Present clear status, risks, opportunities and recovery plans.
• Act as the recognised source of truth for DfX delivery within the category.
________________________________________
KPIs
Business impact
• Annual DfX savings delivered (€)
• DfX contribution to IGM improvement
• Realised versus committed savings
• Savings forecast accuracy
Portfolio management
• DfX funnel coverage versus target
• Number of active DfX initiatives
• Initiative maturity progression
• On-time implementation rate
Governance and execution
• Accuracy and quality of DfX reporting
• Closure rate of critical actions
• Timeliness of risk identification and escalation

The skills and knowledge you’ll bring:

• 7–10 years of experience in program management, product management, procurement, operations, cost engineering or DfX-related roles.
• Proven track record delivering multi-million Euro cost reduction, productivity or margin improvement programmes.
• Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives in consumer durables, electronics, appliances or related industries.
• Strong project and portfolio management skills.
• Strong financial acumen and understanding of savings tracking and business cases.
• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
• Ability to drive execution, challenge stakeholders and deliver results through others.
• Strong communication skills with a high level of ownership, accountability and execution focus.

What we’ll give you in return:

  • Hybrid working model, effectively combining working from the office and home, depending on team dynamics and personal needs
  • High-growth environment, offering exciting learning and career development perspectives beyond your first role

The salary range for this position is EUR 65,000 – EUR 80,000 gross annual (RAL - fixed compensation), corresponding to Level A1 of the CCNL Metalmeccanico (Code: C011), and determined by Versuni’s objective, gender-neutral career framework.

This position also includes a variable compensation component linked to company performance and/or structured incentive schemes.

At Versuni, we are committed to pay transparency and the principle of equal pay for equal work or work of equal value. The final offer within the stated range will be determined based on objective, non-discriminatory criteria, including the specific competencies, professional qualifications, and measurable skills required for the role.

Ready to make an impact?

From developing game-changing air fryers to perfecting the art of coffee making, Versuni’s purpose is turning houses into homes — and we’re calling on your talent to bring it to life. Join our global team of 6,000+ passionate individuals, work with world-class brands, and shape the future of home living. We’re ready for you — are you ready for us?

Job Title

Supervisor de Canales Comerciales - AMBA

¿Qué hace un Supervisor de Canales exitoso en Fiserv?

Un Supervisor de Canales exitoso en Fiserv impulsa el crecimiento del negocio en Small and Medium Business a través de una gestión estratégica de canales comerciales, con el objetivo de ampliar nuestra presencia y participación de mercado.

Este rol administra, desarrolla y potencia diferentes canales de comercialización, atención y operación, como representantes, comercializadoras, call centers y equipos de venta directa, asegurando una cobertura eficiente del mercado y el cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales.

Buscamos una persona con visión comercial, conocimiento del mercado, orientación a resultados y capacidad para desarrollar canales y convertir oportunidades de negocio en crecimiento sostenible.

Lo que harás:

  • Desarrollar y ejecutar la estrategia de canales comerciales para maximizar la presencia de Fiserv en el segmento SMB en AMBA.
  • Administrar, acompañar y potenciar el desempeño de representantes, comercializadoras, call centers, vendedores directos y otros canales de comercialización.
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansión, prospección en campo y generación de cartera comercial a través de canales indirectos y socios estratégicos.
  • Impulsar acciones de prospección y generación de nuevas oportunidades de negocio junto con los canales comerciales.
  • Monitorear pipelines, forecasts, campañas e indicadores de productividad para asegurar una operación comercial eficiente y eficaz.
  • Analizar el mercado local, la competencia y el comportamiento de los comercios para ajustar planes de cobertura, captación y activación.
  • Coordinar el onboarding y la activación de nuevos clientes, acompañando a los canales durante el proceso.
  • Desarrollar relaciones con actores clave del ecosistema comercial local que permitan fortalecer la presencia de Fiserv en AMBA.

Lo que necesitas:

  • 5 años de experiencia en gestión de canales dentro de empresas de adquirencia, medios de pago o servicios financieros.
  • Experiencia en prospección en campo y generación de cartera comercial en soluciones de adquirencia, medios de pago o servicios financieros.
  • Conocimiento del mercado comercial de AMBA y su dinámica local.
  • Capacidad analítica y experiencia en seguimiento de pipelines, forecasts, campañas e indicadores comerciales.
  • Experiencia trabajando con objetivos comerciales y desarrollando acciones para mejorar resultados.

Lo que sería ideal tener (Deseable):

  • Experiencia en venta de soluciones POS, medios de pago o tecnología para comercios.
  • Experiencia en coordinación comercial con canales indirectos, comercializadoras u oficinas de representantes.
  • Experiencia en análisis del mercado local y segmentación de clientes.
  • Experiencia en onboarding comercial y activación de nuevos clientes.

title: Program Management, Director
description:
About FlightSafety International

FlightSafety International is the world’s premier professional aviation training company and supplier of flight simulators, visual systems and displays to commercial, government and military organizations. The company provides training for pilots, technicians and other aviation professionals from 167 countries and independent territories. FlightSafety operates the world’s largest fleet of advanced full-flight simulators and award-winning maintenance training at Learning Centers and training locations in the United States, Canada, France and the United Kingdom.

Purpose of Position

The Director, Program Delivery (Execution) is responsible for the integrated delivery and overall program execution outcomes of highly complex, enterprise-level programs spanning multiple disciplines and lifecycle phases, including development, production, integration, and sustainment.

This role serves as the single point of accountability for program-level integration and delivery outcomes, ensuring alignment to cost, schedule, technical performance, and customer requirements through coordination of execution performed by functional organizations and Control Account Managers (CAMs) or equivalent delivery leads.

The Director leads cross-functional integration across workstreams and ensures cohesive execution through structured program management practices.

The role operates in close partnership with the PMO Center of Excellence (CoE), ensuring adherence to established standards, governance, and Program Controls disciplines, while maintaining clear separation of responsibilities between program integration, functional execution, and controls ownership.

Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Establishes execution strategies, program structures, and operating rhythms aligned to approved program baselines and business objectives
  • Owns and ensures delivery performance against cost, schedule, and technical targets using established performance management frameworks
  • Maintains accountability for program outcomes through integration of performance across functional teams and delivery leads
  • Integrates multiple workstreams into a unified execution model aligned to the program work breakdown structure (WBS) or equivalent delivery framework
  • Manages interdependencies, sequencing, and delivery alignment using integrated scheduling practices (e.g., Integrated Master Schedule or equivalent)
  • Ensures execution accountability resides within functional teams and CAMs or equivalent leads
  • Drives execution coordination and enforces delivery accountability across functional teams without assuming functional reporting authority
  • Partners with the PMO Center of Excellence (CoE) to ensure effective implementation of Program Controls disciplines, including cost management, scheduling, baseline control, and performance reporting frameworks (e.g., EVM or equivalent)
  • Utilizes Program Controls outputs (e.g., performance metrics, variance analysis) to inform execution decisions
  • Supports governance processes including baseline reviews, performance reviews, and audit activities
  • Maintains clear separation between execution leadership, Program Controls ownership, and functional accountability
  • Identifies and manages complex technical, operational, and delivery risks using structured risk management processes
  • Leads issue resolution and escalation management
  • Drives corrective actions to maintain program stability and delivery commitments in coordination with functional organizations and CAMs or equivalent delivery leads
  • Serves as primary interface with executive stakeholders and customers for program execution
  • Leads program governance forums including program reviews, milestone reviews, and decision-making forums
  • Communicates program status, risks, and trade-offs clearly and effectively based on integrated performance data
  • Ensures alignment between stakeholder expectations and execution realities
  • Leads cross-functional program teams and provides direction to Program Managers and integration leads
  • Mentors program leadership on execution strategies, delivery discipline, and risk management and reinforces clear separation of responsibilities across Program Management, Program Controls, and functional execution ownership
  • Promotes a culture of accountability, ownership, and execution excellence

Minimum Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred)
  • Advanced coursework or certifications in program management, systems engineering, or operations management preferred
  • Executive leadership or enterprise program management training desirable

Minimum Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in program management or related leadership roles
  • Demonstrated experience leading large, complex, multi-disciplinary programs with full lifecycle accountability
  • Proven ability to deliver programs in high-visibility, high-risk environments
  • Experience operating within structured program management environments with centralized standards and controls functions

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Expertise in integrating execution of complex, cross-functional programs across multiple lifecycle phases
  • Strong ability to integrate technical, operational, and business workstreams into a cohesive delivery model
  • Advanced capability in program performance management frameworks, risk identification, and issue resolution
  • Ability to partner effectively with a PMO Center of Excellence, ensuring adherence to standards and effective use of Program Controls without direct ownership
  • Strong decision-making capability under uncertainty, including management of competing priorities and constraints
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong leadership capability, including influencing across organizations without direct authority
  • Strong understanding of program performance management frameworks (e.g., EVM or equivalent methodologies)
  • Knowledge of integrated scheduling practices (e.g., IMS or equivalent) and dependency management
  • Experience operating within matrixed organizations with CAM-based or equivalent execution ownership models
  • Working knowledge of PMI knowledge areas, including Integration, Cost, Schedule, Risk, and Stakeholder Management

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met and/or encountered by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation(s) may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and communicate. The employee may be required to stand, walk, and sit. Specific vision abilities required by this job include the ability to view monitors, technical documents, and reference material. The noise level in the work environment is typically low to moderate.

Every cybersecurity initiative at Fiserv passes through architecture, and our team is small, selective, and highly influential by design – which means every architect has a real voice in how security is shaped for the entire company. As our Cybersecurity Architect for Identity & Access Management, you won't be one of dozens of architects; you'll be one of a select few setting the security standards, patterns, and long-term roadmap for a company that processes millions of transactions a day.


The focus is identity, but the work reaches well beyond it – Zero Trust, cloud security across AWS, Azure, and GCP, workforce and customer identity, and the fast-moving world of AI security. You'll work alongside a tight-knit group of specialists across identity, network, cloud, and AI, and you'll bring real-world architectural judgment – not just theory – to some of the most consequential security decisions in fintech. If you've come up through engineering or analyst roles, know how things actually work in production, and want your decisions to shape strategy rather than just execute it, this is the seat.



What you’ll do:

  • Design, review, and govern enterprise identity and access management architecture for both workforce and customer identity, setting the standards, patterns, and long-term roadmap that identity teams across Fiserv build against.
  • Define how identity anchors a Zero Trust strategy, including continuous verification, least-privilege and conditional access, federation, SSO, MFA, and risk-based access controls at the scale of a company that processes millions of transactions a day.
  • Extend identity architecture across AWS, Azure, and GCP and into the rapidly evolving AI landscape, including identity controls for AI tools and agents.
  • Produce formal architecture documentation, including Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and Architecture Requirement Documents (ARDs), that translate business needs into secure, scalable designs.
  • Partner with engineering teams to translate architectural concepts into clear, actionable engineering specifications, and weigh the trade-offs behind every tool and platform decision rather than simply configuring them.
  • Help protect Fiserv from AI-driven attacks while enabling secure adoption of tools such as Copilot, Cloud Cowork, and ChatGPT.
  • Provide specialty and backup coverage alongside a small team of architects spanning network, cloud, AI, and security operations.
  • Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, and risk in terms both technical teams and business leaders can act on.
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


Experience you’ll need to have:

  • 8+ years of cybersecurity and technology experience, with progression from analyst or engineer into architecture (10–12+ years for senior-level architecture roles).
  • Deep identity and access management experience across workforce identity, customer identity, or both, including authentication and authorization models, MFA, SSO, federation, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Demonstrated enterprise architecture experience, including producing formal architecture documents such as ADRs or ARDs, and the ability to explain why a design was chosen, not just how it was configured.
  • Working knowledge of Zero Trust principles and of cloud security across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, with the range to speak across network, cloud, and AI security.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to translate technical risk into recommendations business and technology leaders can act on.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to answer questions succinctly rather than at length.
  • A genuinely curious mindset and track record of staying current with fast-changing technology, especially AI.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent professional/military experience.


Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience covering both workforce and customer identity within a single identity and access management program.
  • Hands-on exposure to identity platforms such as SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft Entra, CyberArk, or Ping, with the architectural perspective to look beyond any single product.
  • Hands-on exposure to AI protection and enablement, including securing tools such as Copilot, Cloud Cowork, or ChatGPT.
  • Experience in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or domain-specific credentials (e.g., SailPoint, CCIE Security).
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading cross-functional architecture reviews.

title: QA Lead
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

QA Lead

About your role:

At Fiserv, we are modernising a high-volume global payment processing platform — moving from a monolithic, batch-driven architecture to an event-driven microservices platform on AWS. This is a ground-up build: Confluent Cloud for event streaming, Aurora PostgreSQL for persistence, Kubernetes for compute, and a modern Java/Kotlin stack throughout.

As a QA Lead, you will own the quality approach for a workstream or project within the modernisation programme. Your focus is the end-to-end flow — proving that systems integrate correctly across domain boundaries, external platforms, and legacy systems, not just that individual services work in isolation. You will define what needs to be tested, build the frameworks to prove it, and give the programme confidence that the integrated system works as expected.

This is a broader view than a single scrum team. You will work across multiple teams, following the transaction flow wherever it goes — across new services, into legacy systems, through external integrations — and own the test strategy for that full path.

This is not a manual testing role. You will be technically strong, comfortable with code, and capable of testing event-driven microservices at the contract, integration, and system level.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the end-to-end test strategy for your workstream — defining how to prove that the full integrated flow works correctly across multiple services, domains, and systems.
  • Test across system boundaries — verifying integration between new platform services, legacy systems, and external platforms (e.g. card schemes, partner systems, upstream channels).
  • Drive parity validation — proving that new platform flows produce the same outcomes as legacy for migrated functionality, defining what “equivalent” means, and building the comparison approach.
  • Define and manage cross-system test scenarios — the integration paths and edge cases that no single scrum team would own or think to test. Build shared test infrastructure — frameworks, test utilities, event assertion tools, and data comparison tooling that support end-to-end validation.
  • Create and curate test data — building representative datasets that exercise the full flow across system boundaries, institution configurations, and transaction scenarios.
  • Work across scrum teams — coaching developers on integration testing approaches, ensuring teams understand the upstream and downstream impact of their changes.
  • Contribute to CI/CD quality gates — ensuring automated integration tests provide fast, reliable feedback without becoming a deployment bottleneck.
  • Identify integration risks early — the failure modes that live at handoff points between systems, where most defects in distributed architectures actually occur.
  • Collaborate with the Quality Architect on programme-level standards and cross-workstream concerns.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • Experience owning quality across system or service boundaries — not just within one team, but across the integration points between multiple systems.
  • Strong technical skills — comfortable with Java or Kotlin, test frameworks (JUnit, TestContainers, or similar), and building automation for distributed systems.
  • Experience testing event-driven or message-based systems — Kafka, async processing, eventual consistency, schema validation, or similar patterns.
  • Experience with migration or parity validation — proving a new system matches an existing one, managing expected differences, and building comparison tooling.
  • Understanding of contract testing approaches (Pact or similar) and how to validate integration points between services and systems.
  • Ability to write SQL and interrogate databases to validate data correctness and transformation logic across system boundaries.
  • Experience working across multiple teams and influencing without direct authority — coaching, setting standards, and raising the bar on integration quality.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Familiarity with payments, financial services, or high-volume transactional domains is a plus but not essential.
  • Exposure to AWS, Kubernetes, or GitLab CI is beneficial.

title: Global Product Manager - Vacuum Cleaners
description:
About the role:

At Versuni, meaningful innovation helps millions of people live healthier and happier lives every day. As the home of brands including Philips, Saeco, Gaggia, Preethi, Philips Walita, L'OR Barista, and Senseo, we are constantly redefining the home experience through products consumers love.

As Product Manager in Versuni, you are the General Manager of your product portfolio, responsible for delivering products that delight consumers and contribute to profitable business growth. You own the product strategy and roadmap for your portfolio from concept to end-of-life, identifying consumer and market opportunities, defining winning value propositions, and leading cross-functional teams to bring products successfully to market.
Acting as the voice of both the consumer and the business, you make critical trade-offs across performance, quality, cost, timing, and profitability to maximize the success of your portfolio. Working with Marketing, R&D, Design, Operations, Sales, and Finance, you align stakeholders around a common vision and lead through influence to deliver outstanding consumer experiences and business results.

The impact you’ll make:

Key Responsibilities
• Own the product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for your Vacuum Cleaner portfolio, translating consumer and market opportunities into clear product requirements and innovation priorities.
• Develop differentiated and compelling value propositions that address consumer needs and create competitive advantage.
• Identify portfolio gaps, price partition opportunities, emerging consumer needs, and technology opportunities through consumer insights, market dynamics, competitive intelligence, and portfolio performance.
• Create and own product business cases, assessing market opportunity, sales potential, pricing, costs, profitability, and ROI.
• Make informed product trade-offs across performance, quality, cost, timing, and profitability to balance consumer and business needs.
• Lead and influence cross-functional teams to align stakeholders, resolve trade-offs, and drive successful product development and launch.
• Team up with Product Project Managers throughout the development process, ensuring consumer needs and product requirements remain central to product decisions.
• Drive product validation through consumer research, product testing, ratings & reviews, and market feedback to ensure a strong consumer experience.
• Partner with Marketing and Design on claims, packaging, and communication to ensure the intended value proposition is consistently brought to life.
• Monitor product and market performance after launch and identify opportunities to improve consumer satisfaction, commercial performance, and portfolio competitiveness.
• Manage product lifecycle activities, including improvements, extensions, animations, cost optimization, and end-of-life planning.
• Support global markets in commercial launch planning and execution, helping ensure new product introductions achieve their intended consumer and business objectives.
• Act as a product expert, continuously building knowledge of competitors, technologies, consumer trends, and category developments.

KPI’s
• Successful Launch of New Products/Innovations: On-time, on-cost, on-quality
• Growth Opportunities: Sales and profitability contribution
• Innovation Thought Leadership: Short- and long-term roadmap development and execution
• Quality & Consumer Satisfaction: Ratings & Reviews and percentage of deliverables meeting standards
• Portfolio Competitiveness: Successful portfolio improvements, extensions, and optimization
• Effective Collaboration: Strong collaboration across R&D, Design, Marketing, Project Management, Operations, and country teams

The skills and knowledge you’ll bring:

• 3–5 years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, Innovation, Marketing, or a related field.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Product Design, Marketing, or a related discipline.

Job Title

Sr SDET

What does a successful Sr. SDET do at Clover?
Software Development Engineers in Test (SDET’s) are a special breed of quality fanatics who use their toolbox of technical talent to automate and scale their testing efforts. When faced with any task, their first reaction is to find an engineering solution. Married to this is a deep knowledge of quality, understanding the test coverage requirements and going beyond them. SDET’s are held to the engineering standards of the developers and simultaneously the quality standards of dedicated QA staff.

Software Development Engineers in Test (SDET) at Clover will help us increase automation coverage and improve our existing automation frameworks. This includes identifying current gaps, if needed - designing a solution, and executing it. The candidate should be familiar with testing concepts and automation tools on Android. This person will support engineers by designing and maintaining cutting-edge automation systems to ensure we deploy code with amazing quality and speed.

What you will do:

  • Develop test automation plans by collaborating with the manual testing team using Zephyr (jira). Work on other non-functional quality attributes, like performance, reliability, and security
  • Develop automated tests with the appropriate technologies. Currently, we are using “UI Automator”(Java) for Android apps. SDET’s will spend most of the time automating test scenarios for android apps
  • Provide the Squad and all stakeholders with clear and real-time updates regarding test status, bug status, and overall quality about the product by monitoring failures, reporting bugs, analyzing & triaging automated tests running in the continuous Integration system
  • Work side-by-side with the development team on testing in parallel and automating tests in our sprints Design and implement tools that improve efficiency in manual testing
  • Research new or better alternate automated testing tools
  • Help maintain systems to monitor test stability and report stability issues back to engineers Keep a learning mindset - look for opportunities to continuously improve yourself, our products, and the practices that we use to build our products


What you will need to have:

  • A minimum of 7+ years of experience in writing reliable and maintainable automated tests. An eagle-eye for test coverage gaps, false positives or negatives and proficiency in black box, functional, and user flow testing techniques
  • Experience working on the Android platform and a very good understanding of the mobile test automation ecosystem
  • 3+ years of professional-level programming skills (regex processing, class design, Map data structure, etc.) in Java
  • Solid foundation in General QA methodologies, including a deep understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and modern testing practices
  • Proven ability to author comprehensive, clear, and actionable bug reports that facilitate rapid resolution by the engineering team
  • Technical proficiency with Android diagnostic tools (ADB, DDMS, Monkey, Memory Analyzer, etc.) and the ability to perform deep log file analysis for root cause identification
  • Experience with software development tools (IDE, debugger, git, JIRA, etc)
  • The passion to build tools that will enable the engineering team to write tests more easily
  • The trait of constantly looking for better solutions to bring down automation flakiness and increase automation reliability, thinking ahead and building for future changes in an ever-changing mobile ecosystem
  • Desire to automate everything and reduce the time required to manually test our products The willingness to work with other teams such as engineering, manual QA, product and release teams
  • A forward-thinking interest in AI/ML technologies, specifically in using AI tools to enhance test coverage, predict flakiness, or increase overall engineering productivity.
  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or other engineering discipline, or equivalent work experience.

What would be great to have:

  • Novice-level Unix shell scripting skills (commands like grep, cut, sed, sort, wget, etc.)
  • Familiarity with JSON objects, SQL queries, data structures

Job Title

Senior Product Manager, Data & AI – Marketing & Loyalty

What does a successful Senior Product Manager, Data & AI – Marketing & Loyalty do at Fiserv?

The Senior Product Manager, Data & AI – Marketing & Loyalty is an end-to-end product leader responsible for defining, building, and commercializing products that combine Fiserv's transaction data, customer and identity signals, analytics, and artificial intelligence. This role will develop capabilities that help clients recognize and understand customers, create more relevant audiences and offers, personalize engagement, and measure incremental outcomes.


This role owns the product lifecycle from customer discovery and strategy through requirements, development, validation, commercialization, adoption, and optimization. Working directly with merchants, financial institutions, partners, and commercial teams, the product manager will identify high-value problems, validate concepts, and turn customer learning into scalable products with measurable client and business value.


What you will do:

  • Own product strategy and capability roadmaps. Define the vision, target customers, use cases, differentiation, business model, success measures, and roadmap for data- and AI-powered marketing and loyalty capabilities.
  • Advance customer intelligence and loyalty offerings. Develop and scale products that use transaction data, first-party customer data, and identity signals to improve customer recognition, audience creation, loyalty engagement, offer relevance, personalization, and marketing measurement. Translate these capabilities into measurable client and business outcomes.
  • Lead customer and market discovery. Engage directly with merchants, financial institutions, partners, prospects, Sales, and client-facing teams to uncover unmet needs and identify opportunities for new features, functionality, and platform enhancements that improve client outcomes and drive business growth. Translate client requirements and customer-specific insights into scalable, repeatable product capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
  • Apply AI where it creates measurable value. Identify where predictive models, recommendations, generative AI, and agents can improve marketer and customer experiences. Define how outputs will be evaluated, understand failure modes and data requirements, prototype concepts, and convert successful experiments into scalable product functionality.
  • Own identity and data requirements. Define how first-party, transaction, identity, audience, and partner data are onboarded, matched, enriched, governed, and activated across online and offline channels. Establish requirements for deterministic and probabilistic matching, coverage, match quality, data lineage, privacy-safe activation, identifier withdrawal, consent, regulatory compliance, and responsible data use.
  • Validate concepts before scaling investment. Use customer interviews, data analysis, prototypes, pilots, actual product usage, and predefined success criteria to test product hypotheses early and determine which capabilities clients value. Make evidence-based decisions to advance, change, stop, or retire initiatives, and maintain scope discipline when proposed features do not demonstrate sufficient customer value, product performance, or commercial potential.
  • Drive product development and delivery. Own capabilities from problem definition through post-launch performance, including the business case, written decisions, requirements Engineering builds from, scope and tradeoffs, release sequencing, and client validation. Partner across Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Design, Legal, Privacy, and Operations to manage dependencies and risks, evaluate usage, and decide whether to optimize, expand, or retire capabilities.
  • Build measurable and trustworthy data products. Define business and product evaluation frameworks for model quality, offer relevance, engagement, incrementality, adoption, and client value. Partner with data and identity teams to incorporate quality, coverage, and match-performance measures, and ensure privacy, governance, explainability, monitoring, and appropriate human controls are built in by design.
  • Own commercialization, launch, and adoption. Partner with Business Development, Sales, Marketing, and Solutions Consulting on positioning, packaging, pricing, enablement, client evaluations, pilots, and adoption strategies. Select the clients best suited for early releases, define the test and evidence required to close each milestone, report results transparently, and use adoption, usage, and commercial feedback to continuously improve the roadmap.
  • Build for an AI-first ecosystem. Define reusable product capabilities, data products, APIs, and workflows that can support human users, client applications, and AI-driven experiences. Establish predictable interfaces, documented inputs and outputs, access controls, and actionable responses so capabilities can be integrated consistently across products and channels.

What you will need to have

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • 6+ years of product management experience, including direct experience building and releasing products in marketing technology, loyalty, offers, personalization, customer data, identity resolution, audience solutions, clean rooms, or marketing measurement.
  • Experience owning a product or significant product capability from customer problem and market opportunity through requirements, development, launch, commercialization, adoption, and optimization.
  • Experience conducting direct customer discovery and translating individual customer needs into scalable, market-relevant product capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of online and offline customer identity data, including deterministic and probabilistic matching, first-party data onboarding, audience creation, privacy-safe activation across channels, identifier withdrawal, and the consent and regulatory constraints governing identity data.
  • Strong data fluency with the ability to independently evaluate customer, transaction, identity, audience, and campaign data; assess coverage and match quality; and use evidence to make product decisions.
  • Practical experience applying AI or machine learning within a product, including defining use cases, evaluation criteria, data requirements, risks, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience supporting product positioning, pricing or packaging, sales enablement, pilots, launches, and adoption.
  • Understanding of payments, merchant acquiring, financial institutions, and the role of transaction data in consumer marketing and loyalty.
  • Experience partnering across Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Design, Privacy/Legal, Sales, Business Development, and other client-facing teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to produce requirements and decision documents that clearly define the customer problem, decision taken, scope and exclusions, tradeoffs, release criteria, and measures of success, and to communicate those decisions to technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

What would be great to have

  • Experience with card-linked or merchant-funded offers, loyalty platforms, retail media, customer data platforms, identity or onboarding providers, clean rooms, demand- or supply-side platforms, marketing decisioning, or measurement solutions.
  • Experience applying transaction data to customer recognition, audience development, personalization, loyalty engagement, offer optimization, or marketing measurement.
  • Experience using modern cloud data platforms to explore large datasets, validate product hypotheses, assess data quality, and support product decisions; experience with Snowflake or Databricks is preferred.
  • Experience with experimentation, attribution, incrementality measurement, recommendations, propensity models, next-best action, or offer optimization.
  • Experience building or distributing B2B data, SaaS, API, marketplace, or data-as-a-service products.
  • Experience prototyping product concepts with current AI tools and designing capabilities that can be consumed by AI agents or machine-driven workflows.

The Senior Project Manager has the overall accountability and responsibility for the progress and successful delivery of the project effort.

What you’ll do:

  • Defining the project brief
  • Setting client expectations in respect of deliverables, plans and management of the project
  • Establishing an appropriate project governance structure, in line with the Fiserv programme/project methodology /governance

Execution & Controls

  • Reporting project status (schedule, cost, benefit, risk, issues and scope) to all stakeholders on a regular basis
  • Organising and facilitating appropriate level of governance meetings, to discuss status reports, provide structured escalation path and determine corrective or preventive actions
  • Managing project risks and issues, ensuring that project team members are actively involved in the identification and where appropriate the ownership of risks, initiating corrective action where necessary
  • Ensuring that project team members are accurately recording their time spent on project tasks and thus tracking budget accurately
  • Building and maintaining a cohesive cross organisation/company project team ethos and fostering productive working relationships, optimally assigning tasks to team members
  • Ensuring the development and approval of all deliverables
  • Refining resource, cost and duration estimate as the project progresses, ensuring that requests for resources for each phase are supplied sufficiently early to enable them to be secured when needed

  • Organising, leading, and motivating a matrix team of Fiserv SME’s and potentially 3rd party resources

  • Ensuring a clean, structured and fully supported transition to BAU

Closeout & Transition

  • Performing contract and project closeout activities, and archiving project information. Where applicable conducting a formal Lessons Learned session and publishing results to all stakeholders

Clover enables merchants to accept payments, run their business and sell more. Come help us transform the way merchants do business, join Clover.

At Clover, payments are at the absolute heart of our merchant experience. The Payments team owns the core transaction platform that processes billions of dollars in volume, serving hundreds of thousands of small and mid-sized businesses globally. We are not just building typical UI screens; we are constructing a highly reliable, low-latency transaction engine that guarantees correctness in every swipe, dip, tap, and click

  • Push the envelope on modernizing our stack; from code to infrastructure.
  • Owning one or more of the web apps that are written in React + Typescript and the backend consists of multiple Java microservices connecting to MySQL.
  • Will work on our payments products like hosted checkouts, virtual components etc, which allows our merchants and consumers to use a variety of different purchase options to make purchases, and improve the user experience on the site to make the site experience seamless and beautiful.
  • As a full stack engineer, you will be expected to work on building new features, contribute to architecting solutions for new features, and ensure all code delivered to production is stable and well-tested.

Job Title

About your role:

You will help build a best-in-class API security program designed for the speed of modern financial services and shape how APIs are secured end-to-end, design through runtime, using cutting-edge protection technologies and analytics, partnering closely with top engineers across product, platform, and security. What you will do:

  • Runtime API protection: Implement and tune runtime controls (e.g., behavioral detection, anomaly and abuse prevention, bot defense, schema enforcement, mTLS/OAuth validation, rate limiting, and threat response) across API gateways, service mesh, and edge layers.

Provide practical guidance aligned to OWASP API Security Top 10 and modern design standards (Open API/JSON Schema).

  • Data analytics and insights: Develop dashboards and analytics using API telemetry and security findings to measure risk, adoption, control effectiveness, and program outcomes. Translate signals into prioritized actions for engineering and leadership.

  • API security governance: Help define governance for API inventories, ownership, classification, security requirements, exception handling, and control validation. Drive consistent standards across teams while enabling delivery velocity.

  • DevSecOps lifecycle partnership: Work with product and platform teams to integrate security requirements into backlog planning, threat modeling, design reviews, testing, release readiness, and incident response.

  • Framework alignment (financial services): Map controls and program outcomes to relevant industry frameworks and expectations (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FAPI, and OWASP guidance). Support audit readiness through clear control documentation and evidence automation.

  • Continuous improvement and innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies and techniques for API discovery, posture management, and runtime detection. Pilot, measure, and scale what works.

What you will need to have:

  • 5+ years related IT and cyber protection experience desired.

  • Strong foundation in API security concepts: authN/authZ (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), session/token handling, scopes/claims, rate limiting, schema validation, and common API abuse patterns.

  • Practical experience with runtime protection in one or more of API gateways, WAF/WAAP, service mesh, ingress controllers, or specialized API security platforms.

  • Experience building automation in CI/CD and cloud-native environments (policy-as-code, scripting, pipelines, Git-based workflows).

  • Experience aligning security controls to financial industry expectations and. producing evidence that stands up to audit scrutiny.

title: JSE Architect and Project Lead
description:
Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate's qualifications, education, skills, and experience as well as market demands. These factors impact the salary/wage offered.

Benefits:

FlightSafety offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes vacation, sick leave, a 401k match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits.

About FlightSafety International

FlightSafety International is the world’s premier professional aviation training company and supplier of flight simulators, visual systems and displays to commercial, government and military organizations. The company provides training for pilots, technicians and other aviation professionals from 167 countries and independent territories. FlightSafety operates the world’s largest fleet of advanced full-flight simulators and award-winning maintenance training at Learning Centers and training locations in the United States, Canada, France and the United Kingdom.

Position Overview

FlightSafety Defense Corporation is gearing to become a recognized architect and operator of complex synthetic environments in support of the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Navy. The JSE Architect and Project Lead serves as the technical foundation for Joint Simulation Environment (JSE) technical management, owning the FSI Defense reference architecture, compliance baseline, and simulation engineering approach across all JSE and Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS) pursuits and delivery. This is a senior individual contributor and team lead role that directly shapes FlightSafety's technical identity in the JSE/SCARS ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

The JSE Architect and Project Lead owns and maintains the FlightSafety JSE/SCARS Reference Architecture, translating complex government standards and technical documentation into actionable internal requirements and design patterns. This includes interpreting SCARS and JSE architectures, standards, and documentation and maintaining compliance checklists and the FSI technical baseline across all relevant bids and programs.

The architect leads architecture reviews for all JSE/SCARS-relevant activities, including authoring technical volumes, supporting oral presentations, and shaping customer solutions. In this capacity, the role drives the alignment of FlightSafety's simulator, visual system, and training service offerings to JSE/SCARS-ready product and integration standards.

The JSE Architect and Project Lead directs research, engineering, and integration activities to design and implement SCARS-compliant upgrades and JSE-ready components, including HLA/DIS/TENA gateways, Common Database (CDB) pipelines, and containerized host packages. The architect is responsible for achieving and demonstrating verified integration of FlightSafety Weapon System Trainers (WSTs) with the JSE via the Global Reusable Interface Domain (GRID) network protocol, including full compliance with the Government Simulation Interface (GSI) Interface Control Document (ICD) and execution of the GSI harness suite of service active tests.

The role includes Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) models and digital twin strategies relevant to JSE/SCARS, and oversees the implementation of DevSecOps pipelines for simulator software and environment content. The architect coordinates with corporate IT and cybersecurity resources to address SCARS-scale security requirements, apply the SCARS Common Security Controls Standard, and support Authority to Operate (ATO) compliance for JSE-connected training devices.

The JSE Architect and Project Lead also establishes and manages the internal JSE/SCARS integration lab — both virtual and classified, as required — and helps build key customer and prime contractor relationships within the JSE/SCARS ecosystem. Travel to government test events is anticipated throughout the year.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in systems engineering, aerospace engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or a closely related technical discipline; master's degree preferred
  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in simulation systems architecture, distributed simulation, or training system development for DoD customers
  • Demonstrated expertise in JSE, SCARS, GRID, or related government simulation frameworks and standards
  • Proficiency in distributed simulation protocols (HLA, DIS, TENA), middlewares such as EMQX, DDS and Apache Kafka, and experience with interface control documents (ICDs) and interface design documents (IDDs)
  • Proficiency in API-driven simulation architectures and frameworks
  • Familiarity with MBSE methodologies and SysML-based system modeling tools (e.g., Cameo Systems Modeler)
  • Experience implementing or managing DevSecOps pipelines internally and in DoD training system environments, including compliance with Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Authority to Operate (ATO) processes
  • Strong technical writing and communication skills with demonstrated experience authoring government proposal volumes, architecture documents, and compliance artifacts
  • Experience leading small teams, multiple projects and adhering to an agile systems engineering approach
  • Hands-on with tools such as JIRA, GitLab, workflow automation, and proficient in C++ and Python
  • Active Secret clearance; ability to obtain Top Secret clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SCARS Increment 5 standards
  • Familiarity with the GSI Software Development Kit (SDK) and GSI test harness execution
  • Experience developing or integrating common aerodynamic models — including Equations of Motion, Forces and Moments, and Mass Properties — in compliance with government architecture standards
  • Experience with Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) and Open Architecture frameworks such as the Unified Command and Control Interface (UCI) or Agile Mission Suite Government Reference Architecture (AMS-GRA)
  • Experience supporting associated government program offices
  • Prior experience in a Chief Architect or lead engineer role on a major simulation or training system program

Why This Role

The JSE Architect and Project Lead is the single most critical technical role in the FlightSafety JSE/SCARS line of efforts. This individual will define how FlightSafety engages a rapidly evolving government simulation enterprise and will directly determine whether the company achieves recognition as a trusted architect and operator of complex synthetic environments by the USAF and Navy. The role carries both technical authority and external visibility, placing the right candidate at the forefront of one of the most strategically important growth areas in defense training systems.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Business Analyst

About your role:

Reporting to the Programme Director and/or Programme Manager, the role of Business Analyst is to support client implementations, conversions and migration initiatives by gathering, analysing and documenting business and functional requirements in line with programme objectives and delivery needs.

Working closely with clients, internal Fiserv teams and third-party partners, the Business Analyst plays a key role in ensuring that business needs are clearly understood, translated into structured functional requirements and aligned to solution capabilities, operational processes and target-state outcomes.

The Business Analyst is responsible for supporting analysis activities across the full project lifecycle, from initial requirements definition and current-state assessment through functional documentation, testing support, go-live readiness and transition to BAU. The role acts as a critical link between business stakeholders, subject matter experts, implementation teams, product, technology and testing teams to help ensure that solutions are delivered in line with business, operational and technical requirements.

Within this context, the role requires a solid understanding of issuing and card-processing environments, including client servicing, operational processes and the impacts of migrating from legacy platforms to modern target solutions.

What you’ll do:

  • Leading business and functional requirements discussions with clients, internal stakeholders and subject matter experts to gather, validate and document project needs.
  • Analysing current-state and target-state processes to identify functional gaps, operational impacts, dependencies and areas requiring clarification or design decisions.
  • Defining and documenting business requirements, functional requirements, process flows, business rules, user stories and other supporting analysis artefacts.
  • Translating business needs into clear, structured and actionable functional requirements for implementation, product, technology and testing teams.
  • Supporting solution definition activities by working closely with SMEs, implementation teams, product teams and technical teams to assess options and recommend appropriate functional approaches.
  • Producing and maintaining analysis documentation across the project lifecycle, including requirements packs, functional specifications, gap analysis, decision logs and process documentation.
  • Developing and maintaining requirements traceability to ensure approved requirements, changes and decisions are tracked and aligned to delivery outcomes.
  • Supporting the documentation of the overall functional approach, including impacts to client processes, operational models, controls and target-state solution design.
  • Identifying, analysing, researching and resolving functional queries raised by internal teams, clients and third-party partners.
  • Supporting impact assessments related to process changes, regulatory and compliance requirements, operational readiness and implementation activities.
  • Working closely with issuing, card-processing and operational stakeholders to ensure that business priorities, processing requirements and client expectations are clearly understood and reflected in the solution.
  • Supporting readiness activities by ensuring that requirements, process impacts, decisions and functional dependencies are clearly understood by all relevant stakeholders.
  • Acting as a key liaison between business stakeholders and delivery teams throughout the implementation lifecycle, ensuring clear communication and alignment at all stages.

Execution & Controls

  • Managing and maintaining business analysis deliverables in accordance with established Fiserv governance, standards and project methodology.
  • Supporting the planning, prioritisation and delivery of business analysis activities in line with project milestones, implementation phases and delivery timelines.
  • Ensuring that requirements are reviewed, validated, approved and baselined in line with agreed governance processes.
  • Tracking requirement changes, open points, assumptions, dependencies and key decisions throughout the lifecycle of the project.
  • Supporting the creation and maintenance of functional documentation required for implementation, testing, readiness and go-live activities.
  • Working with implementation, product, technology and testing teams to ensure requirements are fully understood and correctly translated into solution design and delivery outputs.
  • Supporting testing activities by reviewing test scenarios, validating coverage against requirements and assisting with defect analysis, functional clarifications and issue resolution.
  • Supporting user acceptance testing, operational readiness assessments and go-live preparation from a functional and business process perspective.
  • Participating in governance meetings, status reviews, workshops and working sessions to provide updates on analysis progress, requirement status, key decisions and unresolved issues.
  • Escalating risks, issues, requirement gaps or delivery concerns to the appropriate stakeholders in a timely and structured manner.
  • Maintaining clear and consistent communication with clients, internal teams and third parties on requirements, impacts, decisions and functional changes.
  • Supporting implementation events and critical project milestones by providing functional expertise and analysis support where required.

Closeout & Transition

  • Confirming that business and functional requirements have been delivered, validated and transitioned appropriately into implementation, testing, warranty and BAU support processes.
  • Supporting the completion of final documentation and ensuring that approved requirements, decisions and analysis artefacts are archived appropriately.
  • Assisting with the review of implementation outcomes, requirement coverage, defects and lessons learned to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensuring that outstanding functional queries, requirement gaps or follow-up actions are tracked through to closure or transitioned appropriately into warranty and BAU support processes.
  • Contributing to post-implementation reviews and Lessons Learned activities where applicable.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with professional proficiency in both English and Italian.
  • Working knowledge of issuing, card-processing and payments operations, with an understanding of how business requirements translate into processing and operational outcomes.
  • Subject Matter Expert / Business Analyst experience in one or more of the following areas strongly preferred: Regulatory, Compliance, Payment Schemes, Card Processing, Customer Correspondence, Fulfillment, Collections, Risk/Fraud, Disputes, Chargebacks, Retrievals, Testing, Consumer Finance, Credit Cards, Loans, Debit Cards and Retail Cards.
  • Significant proven experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, functional analysis or solution analysis roles, within the Financial Services industry, in the Cards and Payments sector; experience in card and/or payment processing environments is preferred (6-10 years).
  • Proven experience supporting and/or leading business analysis activities for medium to large client-facing implementations, conversions or migration initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and workstreams.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Business Analysis certification or equivalent professional training preferred.
  • Experience in issuing, card-processing or broader consumer finance environments strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting migrations from legacy platforms to modern processing platforms.
  • Experience working on multi-country programmes and complex client delivery initiatives.
  • Exposure to regulatory, operational or processing change initiatives within issuing environments preferred.

Salary starting at €52,470 - negotiable depending on experience
