Job Title

Senior Business Analyst

About your role:

This is a leadership role that demands deep payments domain expertise, exceptional client-facing skills, the ability to navigate ambiguity in complex programmes, and a track record of leading analysis workstreams in large-scale regulated environments.

The ideal candidate will bring strong consultative skills honed through direct client engagement, the confidence to shape solutions where requirements are unclear or evolving, and the ability to mentor and lead other analysts. They will also demonstrate the practical application of AI in business analysis, including the use of AI-enabled tools to accelerate requirements gathering, improve documentation quality, automate analysis tasks, and enhance traceability and validation.

What you’ll do:

Leadership & Client Engagement

  • Act as a trusted adviser to senior client stakeholders, building and maintaining strong relationships at Director and VP level.
  • Lead and mentor a team of business analysts, setting standards for quality, consistency, and delivery.
  • Own the analysis workstream end-to-end, taking accountability for scope, quality, and timely delivery of all BA outputs.
  • Represent the programme in client-facing governance forums, steering committees, and executive reviews.
  • Navigate ambiguity confidently — proactively clarifying scope, surfacing assumptions, and driving decisions where requirements are incomplete or conflicting.
  • Influence and negotiate with stakeholders across organisational boundaries to align priorities and resolve competing demands.
  • Coach junior analysts in structured thinking, stakeholder management, and payments domain knowledge.

Requirements Gathering & Business Analysis

  • Lead discovery workshops with business stakeholders, technology teams, and external partners to elicit, analyse, document, and validate business and functional requirements.
  • Analyse existing credit card issuing and processing workflows, identify gaps, and define future-state requirements aligned to migration objectives.
  • Decompose complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, actionable requirements — even where source documentation is limited or stakeholder views conflict.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate requirements discovery and summarisation, improve consistency and quality of requirement definitions, and support impact analysis and dependency identification.
  • Ensure requirements are clear, testable, traceable, and aligned with business outcomes.
  • Proactively identify risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies (RAID) and escalate appropriately.

Migration Analysis & Planning

  • Lead the design and execution of credit card platform migration strategies, ensuring minimal customer and operational disruption.
  • Define and validate data mapping, transformation rules, reconciliation requirements, and cutover dependencies.
  • Drive planning and validation of parallel runs, rehearsals, and migration checkpoints, with a focus on data integrity and regulatory compliance.
  • Anticipate downstream impacts and dependencies across multiple workstreams, proactively managing cross-functional alignment.

Process & Functional Documentation

  • Produce and own high-quality business process models, functional specifications, migration artefacts, and data definitions.
  • Maintain end-to-end requirements traceability from business need through design, build, and test.
  • Use AI-enabled documentation tools to improve accuracy and completeness, reduce manual effort, and identify inconsistencies or gaps across requirement sets.
  • Establish documentation standards and templates for the BA team.

Testing, Validation & Readiness

  • Define UAT strategy and acceptance criteria in collaboration with client and delivery teams.
  • Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and system integration testing activities related to migrated functionality.
  • Validate migrated data, business rules, and processing outcomes against defined requirements.
  • Ensure solutions meet security, regulatory, and operational readiness standards.

Stakeholder & Delivery Collaboration

  • Act as the primary liaison between business units, technology teams, delivery partners, and vendors.
  • Drive project leadership with status reporting, impact assessments, risk identification, and decision papers.
  • Contribute to governance forums and working sessions with clear, data-driven insights and recommendations.
  • Build consensus across diverse stakeholder groups, managing expectations and resolving conflict constructively.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • Experience leading and mentoring BA teams (3+ analysts) on complex programmes.
  • Deep understanding of credit card issuing, processing platforms, and payment ecosystems (8+ years in payments or financial services).
  • Strong hands-on experience with VisionPLUS / FirstVision platforms for credit and debit card management.
  • Experience with leading card processing platforms (FirstVision, CMS, TSYS, etc.).
  • Knowledge of ISO 8583 messaging, APIs, and service-based integrations in card processing.
  • Experience with BPM/process modelling tools (e.g., Visio, Miro, Lucidchart).
  • Familiarity with data analysis tools (SQL, Excel advanced, Power BI).
  • Multiple platform migration or major transformation programmes within payments or financial services.
  • Working knowledge of payments regulatory requirements, including PCI DSS, PSD2, and local regulations.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Professional certifications (e.g., CBAP, PMP, payments-specific certifications) are highly desirable.

This position is responsible for administering and governing the enterprise Power BI platform while designing, developing, and supporting scalable business intelligence solutions. • Design and develop executive dashboards, operational reports, paginated reports, semantic models, reusable datasets, dataflows, and self-service analytics solutions.

• Develop Power BI analytics and semantic models using Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse data, including secure extraction, transformation, integration, and reporting across business applications.

• Develop advanced DAX measures, Power Query transformations, dimensional models, calculation groups, aggregations, incremental refresh, and performance-optimized reporting solutions.

• Implement and support Row-Level Security, Object-Level Security, Microsoft Entra ID group-based access, sensitivity labels, and least-privilege access controls.

• Partner with database, cloud, networking, security, and application teams to troubleshoot data connectivity, authentication, gateway, refresh, and performance issues.

• Establish source control, code review, automated testing, release management, and CI/CD practices using Git and Azure DevOps.

• Mentor Power BI developers, review solution designs, enforce development standards, and promote reusable architecture patterns and documentation.

• Support Microsoft Fabric evaluations and implementations using OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, notebooks, pipelines, semantic models, and Fabric capacity management.

• Communicate risks, dependencies, technical constraints, and remediation plans clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

What you will need to have:

• Minimum 7 to 10 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, data engineering, or application development, including at least 4 years of hands-on Power BI experience.

• Hands-on experience administering Power BI Service in an enterprise environment, including tenant settings, workspaces, capacities, gateways, security, governance, and monitoring.

• Strong Power BI development experience with Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, Power Query (M), semantic modeling, dataflows, deployment pipelines, and performance tuning.

• Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, data warehousing, metadata, lineage, and data quality concepts.

• Strong SQL knowledge, including complex queries, joins, window functions, views, stored procedures, query optimization, and troubleshooting.

• Backend knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, authentication and authorization, batch processing, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse data integration, and application-to-database connectivity.

• Experience with Azure SQL Database, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, or comparable enterprise data platforms.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse, including core data structures, security roles, environments, solution-aware delivery, and integration with Power BI and Azure services.

• Experience implementing RLS, OLS, Entra ID group-based permissions, service principals, managed identities, gateway security, and least-privilege access.

• Understanding of Power BI licensing, capacity planning, refresh limitations, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational support processes.

• Good understanding of Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Agile/Scrum delivery, change management, and production support.

• Education: BE/BTech/MCA/MTech/BSc or equivalent graduate qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data, or a related discipline.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

• Experience working with distributed teams across India, US, APAC, or UK time zones.

What would be great to have: (Optional - subjective preferred qualifications if applicable.)

• Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, notebooks, pipelines, Direct Lake, semantic models, Real-Time Intelligence, and Fabric capacity management.

• Experience planning or executing migration from traditional Power BI, Azure Synapse, or other data platforms to Microsoft Fabric.

• Experience with Python, PySpark, C#/.NET, PowerShell, or automation using Power BI REST APIs and Microsoft Graph.

• Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 applications (such as Sales, Customer Service, or Field Service), Dataverse, Snowflake, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, or other modern cloud data platforms.

Job Title

Deposit Growth Consultant

Overview

As a key member of the Deposit Growth Consulting team within Advisory Services, you will help financial institutions improve deposit acquisition, retention, relationship depth, product profitability, and overall financial performance. You will combine industry expertise, data analysis, and strategic consulting skills to identify opportunities, develop actionable recommendations, and guide clients through initiatives that drive measurable business results.

This role is ideal for an experienced banking professional who can independently analyze complex data, lead client engagements, communicate with executive leadership, and translate insights into practical strategies that help financial institutions achieve their growth objectives.

Primary Responsibilities

Client Engagement and Consulting

· Lead deposit growth consulting engagements from discovery through final delivery, managing timelines, data requests, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations.

· Facilitate workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions with executive, product, operations, retail, business, and commercial banking leaders.

· Assess deposit portfolios, product structures, pricing strategies, customer behavior, competitive positioning, and market opportunities.

· Evaluate consumer, business, and commercial deposit offerings to identify opportunities for growth, simplification, profitability improvement, and stronger customer engagement.

· Develop executive-ready presentations, reports, recommendations, and prioritized action plans tailored to each client’s objectives.

· Present findings and recommendations to client leadership and facilitate decision-making discussions.

Data Analysis and Strategic Recommendations

· Analyze financial, product, customer, market, and competitive data to identify revenue and growth opportunities.

· Validate and reconcile client data, identify material data limitations, and communicate assumptions appropriately.

· Translate complex data sets into meaningful business insights and practical recommendations.

· Develop strategies focused on deposit acquisition and retention, balance growth and mix, product penetration, relationship expansion, pricing, cost of funds, fee income, and profitability.

· Help clients prioritize initiatives based on expected business impact, resource requirements, implementation complexity, and organizational readiness.

Business Development and Practice Growth

· Support sales and business development efforts through discovery calls, solution discussions, proposals, and client presentations.

· Help develop statements of work, project scopes, business requirements, effort estimates, and engagement approaches.

· Identify appropriate follow-on services and expansion opportunities based on client needs uncovered during engagements.

· Contribute to team revenue objectives while maintaining high standards for client satisfaction and delivery quality.

Methodology and Team Development

· Partner with Advisory Services leadership to enhance consulting methodologies, analytical models, standardized reporting, deliverables, and engagement capabilities.

· Develop and maintain reusable consulting templates, frameworks, tools, and other practice assets.

· Mentor and support less experienced consultants and team members.

· Maintain awareness of deposit market trends, competitive practices, regulatory considerations, and emerging financial-services capabilities.

Required Qualifications

· 5+ years of experience working with consumer, business, and/or commercial deposit products and services, including experience in areas such as product design, pricing, implementation, marketing, portfolio management, or data analysis.

· 5+ years of experience in banking or the financial services industry; banking experience is strongly preferred.

· Demonstrated experience analyzing financial, product, customer, or operational data and converting findings into business recommendations.

· Experience leading client-facing projects, strategic initiatives, or consulting engagements from initiation through completion.

· Experience developing project scopes, business requirements, statements of work, and professional client deliverables.

· Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with C-level executives, business leaders, operational stakeholders, and technical teams.

· Strong project management, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills in complex or ambiguous situations.

· Experience developing clear, executive-ready findings, recommendations, presentations, and implementation roadmaps.

· Experience mentoring, coaching, or training less experienced team members.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and related Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in banking consulting, advisory services, or management consulting.

· Knowledge of deposit applications within one or more Fiserv core banking platforms, including DNA, Premier, Cleartouch, Precision, or Finxact.

· Experience working with and presenting to executive management at financial institutions.

· Knowledge of deposit pricing, relationship pricing, relationship rewards, product profitability, treasury services, analyzed accounts, or balance growth strategies.

· Experience with analytical and reporting tools such as SQL, Snowflake, Cognos, Power BI, or similar platforms.

· Experience supporting sales pursuits, opportunity development, proposal development, or consulting solution design.

Education

· Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, analytics, marketing, banking, or a related field preferred.

· An equivalent combination of education, banking experience, and consulting experience will be considered.

Success in This Role

· Independently lead well-structured consulting engagements and consistently deliver high-quality work.

· Build trusted relationships with financial institution executives and key stakeholders.

· Convert complex financial and customer information into clear, actionable recommendations.

· Help clients identify and prioritize opportunities that improve deposit growth and financial performance.

· Identify appropriate growth opportunities for clients and the Deposit Growth Consulting practice.

· Contribute to the continued development of standardized, scalable consulting capabilities.

Typical Engagements

· Deposit growth assessments and portfolio reviews

· Consumer, small business, and commercial deposit product strategy

· Product and pricing reviews

· Relationship pricing and relationship rewards strategy

· Product rationalization and simplification

· New-account and onboarding optimization

· Deposit market and competitive analysis

Product profitability, cost-of-funds, and balance-mix reviews

title: Internship: HR
description:
About the role:

In this role, you have the opportunity to step into Human Resources in an international consumer company and learn how HR supports people and business across Italy and Southern Europe. Over up to 12 months, you will build hands-on experience across the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding and with a focus on people projects

The impact you’ll make:

You are responsible for:

  • Coordinating onboarding and offboarding activities
  • Contributing to HR projects such as pay transparency, pay equity certification, training planning and engagement initiatives
  • Helping organize internal events, and employee communications for the Milan office

Your 12-month learning path

  • First 6 months, Foundations: learn HR processes, tools and Italian employment basics, support defined HR projects, and take ownership of onboarding and local engagement initiatives
  • Extension (months 7–12), Ownership: take on greater autonomy, lead a defined HR project from start to finish and gain exposure to regional South Europe HR topics. The extension is subject to a positive mid-point review and an updated training project (progetto formativo).

You will be part of the HR South Europe team, a small, supportive and dynamic team that partners with the business across Italy, France, Spain and Greece. You will be based in our Milan office, report to the South Europe Lead and work closely with HR Managers, Payroll & Administration and line managers across functions. Expect a hands-on, collaborative environment where you learn by doing and your ideas are welcome.

The skills and knowledge you’ll bring:

• A recent Bachelor's or Master's degree (or graduating soon) in Human Resources, Law, Business or Labour studies
• Eligibility for an extracurricular internship under Regione Lombardia rules (e.g. recent graduate, no previous internship with Versuni)
• Fluent Italian (C1) and English (C1), written and spoken
• Strong organization, attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion
• A proactive, curious and team-oriented attitude, with clear communication skills

What we’ll give you in return:

A structured 6+6 month learning journey in an international HR team, with a dedicated tutor, regular feedback and real responsibility from day one. You will receive a monthly internship allowance of 800e and meal vouchers, hybrid working and access to training, building a strong foundation for a career in HR.

Versuni is quick to recognize emerging talent and nurture success. If you are passionate about what you do and determined to be successful we will support you and your career development. There are no wrong questions at Versuni and we challenge our employees and graduates alike to ask and learn. Versuni is rapidly evolving which creates an exciting and vibrant work environment.

Ready to make an impact?

From developing game-changing air fryers to perfecting the art of coffee making, Versuni’s purpose is turning houses into homes — and we’re calling on your talent to bring it to life. Join our global team of 6,000+ passionate individuals, work with world-class brands, and shape the future of home living. We’re ready for you — are you ready for us?

title: Flight Instructor - Wichita East
description:
About FlightSafety International

FlightSafety International is the world’s premier professional aviation training company and supplier of flight simulators, visual systems and displays to commercial, government and military organizations. The company provides training for pilots, technicians and other aviation professionals from 167 countries and independent territories. FlightSafety operates the world’s largest fleet of advanced full-flight simulators and award-winning maintenance training at Learning Centers and training locations in the United States, Canada, France and the United Kingdom.

Location

This role is onsite at our Wichita East location in Wichita, KS. FlightSafety does provide relocation for candidates who currently reside outside the Wichita Metropolitan area.

Purpose of Position

The Flight Instructor delivers exceptional ground and simulator flight instruction in accordance with aviation regulations and FlightSafety Training principles.

Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Conduct pilot ground and simulator training for clients receiving core, specialty or enrichment training courses.
  • Develop and prepare training materials that support training delivery to meet the client needs in accordance with the applicable curriculum.
  • Evaluate and measure trainee progress and recommend for qualification, or additional training.
  • Complete accurate training records specific to each client, aiding their success in achieving the requested objective(s).
  • Identify client training issues and seek assistance prior to execution.
  • Maintain Instructor qualifications in accordance with regulatory requirements.

Minimum Experience

  • Must be able and willing to participate in FlightSafety's DOT Drug and Alcohol testing program
  • Preferred: An unrestricted ATP certificate, or an ICAO member state Airline Transport Pilot License
  • If no ATP, must meet the requirements of:
  • 14 CFR part 61.153
  • 14 CFR part 61.64 without a Supervised Operating Experience (SOE) limitation.
  • Preferred: A minimum of one unrestricted PIC type rating;
  • Preferred: FAR Part 135, FAR Part 121, or military training experience;
  • Preferred: 2,500 hours of total flight time, 1500 hours of multi-engine time

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Knowledge of aviation safety standards and practices
  • Knowledge of common aviation regulations
  • Ability to manage classes and teach effectively
  • First-level facilitation skills
  • First-level customer service skills
  • Ability to be coachable and receive feedback to support development

Physical Demands and Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee may be required to stand; walk; sit; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and taste or smell.

Must possess physical range of body motion to perform the following: Reach, exert pressure and manipulate the rudder controls and/or anti-torque with both feet. Reach and manipulate numerous controls within the Simulator device from the Instructor's chair. Enter and exit from the Simulator device via the provided ramp. Move between the Instructor station, screen and podium while instructing in the classroom. Exit from malfunctioned Simulator while the device is in a severely pitched attitude. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, and frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee frequently works near moving mechanical parts. The employee may work in high, precarious places and in outside weather conditions and is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, extreme cold, extreme heat, risk of electrical shock, risk of radiation, and vibration.

FlightSafety is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Vet/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Any offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of required compliance reviews, including verification that the candidate is not prohibited from employment under U.S. economic sanctions programs administered by the U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC).

This position may require access to export-controlled technology or services subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment consideration and any offer of employment are contingent upon the applicant’s ability to comply with these requirements, including qualifying as a “U.S. Person” under applicable regulations or otherwise eligible for export authorization within a timeframe consistent with business needs. A “U.S. Person” includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (holders of approved and unexpired green cards), and certain refugees or asylees with protected status under U.S. law.

This position may also require eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance for the duration of employment.

Cybersecurity Notice: All official recruiting communication from FlightSafety International will come from an @flightsafety.com email address. FlightSafety International will never ask for personal or financial information through social media or third-party email providers.

This role combines hands-on software engineering with architecture and technical leadership across highly distributed, event-driven systems. You will help define and implement scalable messaging patterns and services using Golang, Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, REST, gRPC, and cloud-native technologies.
You will work across engineering teams to improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operability of our eventing platform while establishing architectural standards and engineering practices for asynchronous communication. Experience with change data capture technologies, including CDC and Debezium, is highly valuable for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and evolve highly scalable, resilient, and maintainable event-driven services and messaging platform capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance for distributed systems and event-driven application architectures.
  • Develop production services and platform components using Golang.
  • Design and implement scalable event streaming and messaging solutions using Apache Kafka.
  • Define architectural patterns and engineering standards for producers, consumers, topics, schemas, event contracts, retries, error handling, and message processing.
  • Design solutions that account for ordering, delivery guarantees, idempotency, backpressure, failure recovery, and distributed-system failure scenarios.
  • Develop APIs and supporting services using REST and gRPC where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with application, platform, database, and architecture teams to integrate event-driven capabilities across the Finxact platform.
  • Design, deploy, and operate containerized services within Kubernetes environments.
  • Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable and repeatable delivery of messaging services.
  • Analyze performance, scalability, and reliability characteristics of event-driven systems and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues involving event processing, service communication, Kafka, databases, and distributed systems.
  • Establish observability practices for messaging platforms, including metrics, logging, tracing, lag monitoring, and operational alerting.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, technical design sessions, code reviews, and performance analysis.
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on Golang, Kafka, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native development.
  • Influence technical direction across teams and drive consistency in messaging architecture and engineering practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience designing, developing, and supporting production software systems.
  • Significant experience with software architecture, technical design, and technical leadership for complex distributed systems.
  • 5+ years of Golang development experience building production applications, services, or platform components.
  • Strong experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures.
  • Strong production experience with Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, offsets, retention, and delivery semantics.
  • Experience designing messaging systems for scalability, resiliency, throughput, availability, and failure recovery.
  • Strong understanding of distributed-system concepts including concurrency, consistency, idempotency, fault tolerance, backpressure, and asynchronous processing.
  • Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and gRPC services.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes and containerized application architectures, including deployment, scaling, configuration, resiliency, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating applications with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
  • Experience operating applications and distributed services in AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar cloud environments.
  • Experience with automated testing, integration testing, performance testing, observability, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to translate business and product requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs across engineering teams and technology leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work, and/or military experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Change Data Capture (CDC) architectures and patterns.
  • Debezium for database change streaming and event generation.
  • Kafka Connect and connector-based integration architectures.
  • Designing high-volume, low-latency messaging or transaction-processing platforms.
  • Event schemas, schema evolution, compatibility strategies, and schema registries.
  • Designing replay, retry, dead-letter, and recovery strategies for event-driven systems.
  • Cross-region or highly available Kafka architectures.
  • Event sourcing, stream processing, or other advanced event-driven design patterns.
  • Infrastructure-as-code and automated infrastructure provisioning.
  • Defining reusable platform capabilities, architectural standards, or messaging frameworks used by multiple development teams.
  • Mentoring senior engineers and providing technical leadership across multiple engineering teams.
  • Banking, payments, fintech, or other high-volume transactional environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong technical problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Deep appreciation for reliability, scalability, performance, and operational simplicity in distributed systems.
  • Ability to think beyond individual services and understand end-to-end event flows and system behavior.
  • Demonstrated ownership and accountability for critical production systems.

Job Title

O que um(a) Senior Technical Delivery Manager bem-sucedido(a) faz na Fiserv?

Na Fiserv, o(a) Senior Technical Delivery Manager desempenha um papel estratégico na condução e entrega de iniciativas de tecnologia que impulsionam nossos negócios na América Latina. Esta pessoa atua como elo entre áreas de tecnologia, produto, operações e negócios, garantindo alinhamento, transparência e execução eficiente de projetos complexos.

Seu trabalho é fundamental para acelerar a inovação, fortalecer a colaboração entre equipes e garantir a entrega de soluções que gerem valor para nossos clientes e para o negócio.

  • Liderar o planejamento, acompanhamento e governança de iniciativas de tecnologia, desde a concepção até a implementação.

  • Promover a aplicação consistente de metodologias, controles e práticas de gestão alinhadas aos padrões do PMO e às necessidades de cada iniciativa.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos, programas ou entregas de tecnologia em ambientes complexos, matriciais e multifuncionais.
  • Conhecimento em planejamento de entregas, gestão de riscos, gestão de dependências, forecast, governança e reporte executivo.
  • Capacidade de influenciar stakeholders em diferentes níveis da organização e conduzir iniciativas sem autoridade formal sobre equipes ou orçamento.

  • Proficiência profissional em português e espanhol.

Nossa Cultura

Na Fiserv, nossa aspiração é mover dinheiro e informações de forma que impulsione o mundo. Fazemos isso por meio de inovação contínua, tecnologia de ponta e excelência na entrega de soluções que ajudam pessoas e empresas a prosperarem.

Job Title

Product Manager, Card Not Present Payments

As a Sr. Product Manager you’ll drive the strategy, execution, and continuous optimization for key features within Clover’s Card Not Present (CNP) payments portfolio, including e-commerce APIs and integrations, alternative payment methods, authorization optimization, and payment system compliance.


This is an individual contributor role at the heart of Clover’s omnichannel strategy, focused on expanding merchant features, growing transaction volume, and delivering seamless digital payment experiences. You’ll work closely across engineering, product design, product marketing, developer relations, and sales channels to build and scale market-leading solutions.


Product Strategy

  • Contribute to the card-not-present payment product strategy aligned with Clover’s overall mission, target vertical markets, and growth objectives.
  • Execute on the product vision and feature roadmap across Clover’s e-commerce, mobile, and API/SDK capabilities, addressing merchant needs and market opportunities.
  • Help identify emerging trends and technologies in online payments and alternative payment methods to drive competitive differentiation.
  • Define our e-commerce integrations and developer partner strategy spanning key platforms and third-party developer solutions.
  • Present product feature updates, performance metrics, and feature roadmaps to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.

Product Development & Roadmapping

  • Drive the end-to-end product development lifecycle from ideation through launch, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery of secure, scalable online payment capabilities.
  • Develop deep understanding of Clover’s target merchant segments (restaurant, retail, services, healthcare) and translate segment-level needs into CNP product roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and design teams to define technical requirements and payment API/SDK specifications.
  • Manage semi-annual card brand compliance mandates, PCI requirements, and regional payment and security rules.
  • Translate product delivery into measurable revenue growth, high-margin transaction volume, and improved authorization rates.

Go-To-Market

  • Partner closely with product marketing, commercialization, sales channels, and developer relations to train sales teams and educate the market on Clover's CNP capabilities.
  • Collaborate with developer outreach and partner teams to support third-party developers building on Clover e-commerce APIs.

Customer Focus

  • Help conduct in-depth market and user research to understand merchant and consumer pain points and the competitive landscape.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback, operational data, decline rates, fraud rates, and other data to understand opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention by delivering secure, compliant, and reliable payment experiences.



What You Will Need to Have:

Job Title

Senior MongoDB Database Engineer

About your role:

As a Senior MongoDB Database Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, optimizing, and operating high-throughput, low-latency MongoDB platforms supporting mission-critical workloads at enterprise scale. You will bring hands-on experience with multi-terabyte to petabyte-scale clusters and architect resilient, high-performing sharded environments under heavy production load.

  • Architect and operate large-scale sharded clusters using range-based and hash-based strategies

  • Manage cross-shard query efficiency and reduce scatter-gather impact across distributed workloads
  • Support large production environments (hundreds of nodes, multi-region deployments) with a focus on availability and resilience
  • Implement and maintain high availability, disaster recovery, and failover strategies across regions
  • Automate database operations, monitoring, and maintenance tasks using Python or shell scripting
  • Partner with application teams on data modeling, query design, and performance best practices

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 6+ years of experience as a MongoDB Engineer or DBA in large-scale production environments

  • 2+ years of experience with Python, Powershell, RedHat Linux, Mac OS, IIS, and Active Directory
  • 2+ years with cloud technologies such as Google Cloud and Azure
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of education, work, or military experience

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Prior experience in the financial services industry
  • Experience with database migration projects
  • Prior exposure to microservices architectures, distributed systems, or streaming platforms
  • Knowledge of complex technologies, tools, methodologies, the enterprise architecture, and emerging technologies in the industry

  • This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment

Travel:

title: Adams' Kitchen Associate I (Full Time, Flexible Schedule)
description:
Kitchen Associate I

Reports To: Kitchen Manager


Who we are at Adams


At Adams, we prioritize creating a warm and welcoming environment for both our customers and team members. We believe exceptional customer service goes beyond meeting needs—it’s about treating everyone with genuine respect, kindness, and appreciation. Each team member is expected to greet customers personally, serve them with friendly, polite, and knowledgeable assistance, and always put customer needs above other tasks. Additionally, we value a workplace where employees treat each other with the same courtesy and respect as our customers, fostering a collaborative and supportive atmosphere that reflects our commitment to service excellence.


What we’re looking for


Adams employees are expected to provide friendly service to our valuable customers, ensuring that each experience reflects the commitment to providing quality products that Adams is known for. For the Kitchen Associate I, this means providing dependable support in food preparation, maintaining a clean and organized work environment, following safety and quality standards, and working efficiently to help ensure fresh, high-quality products are ready for our customers.


Your Day-to-Day

  • Provide friendly, knowledgeable service and assist customers with orders in person and over the phone
  • Stock, rotate, and label products to ensure freshness, quality, and appealing displays
  • Keep the hot bar, cold cases, and salad bar full, clean, and up to quality standards
  • Monitor product levels and communicate with cooks when items run low
  • Receive, weigh, and store deliveries accurately
  • Maintain cleanliness in all areas, including dishes, counters, cases, and prep spaces
  • Prioritize customer assistance over tasks to ensure a positive shopping experience

What you bring to the Farm

  • Knowledge and willingness to learn the inter-workings of the Kitchen
  • Able to bring a friendly and helpful environment to all customers
  • Ability to demonstrate and set the example for Adams’ culture and values
  • Willingness to work collaboratively and communicate with a team of co-workers and managers
  • Exhibit enthusiasm, positivity and/or knowledge about Adams’ products and quality

Working Conditions

  • Must be 18 years old
  • Consistently move, adjust, and position items weighing up to 50 pounds
  • Ability to remain in a stationary position for duration of shift
  • Safely operate and use knives, slicer, and any other equipment needed to operate the department
  • Occasionally ascend/descend a stepstool, stepladder, and/or ladder
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers for duration of shift
  • Communicate with others to exchange information
  • Moving self in different positions to accomplish tasks including in tight and confined spaces
  • Be able to concentrate on tasks in order to avoid injury and waste of product

Perks of the Job


At Adams, we believe in recognizing and rewarding excellent work with competitive compensation and meaningful benefits. In addition to quality compensation, at Adams you can expect generous medical, dental and vision coverage (for applicable roles), voluntary benefits like pet insurance, paid time off and holiday pay, flexible pay schedules with DailyPay, and best of all, our generous Employee Discount.


The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions – including skill sets, experience, training, certifications and other business needs.


At Adams, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each situation. We’re committed to providing a supportive and rewarding environment that helps our team members thrive—both professionally and personally.

The Product Operations & GTM Manager is the operational backbone of the CashFlow Central (CFC) product organization, enabling the team to plan, launch, and scale CFC's accounts payable and accounts receivable capabilities for financial institution clients and their small-business customers. The role runs Product Operations, partners with Growth Partners, Sales, and Marketing to execute CFC's Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy, leads the Operations and GTM tracks of the AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), and serves as the product team's operational partner to Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Internal Audit.

    • Partner with Product Managers, Growth Partners, Sales, and Marketing to turn product strategy into GTM plans: target segments, value propositions, messaging, launch tiers, and timelines.

About your role: This is your chance to build something from scratch: a brand-new AI-driven cybersecurity engineering capability at one of the largest fintechs on the planet. As Senior Advisor, Software Engineering on our AI Security Engineering team, you won't be babysitting legacy tools – you'll be architecting and scaling the agentic AI frameworks, platforms, and cloud-native systems that define how Fiserv detects, investigates, and shuts down threats for years to come. You'll team up across cybersecurity, cloud engineering, data engineering, application development, and enterprise architecture to ship secure, production-grade AI solutions on Google Cloud – with the runway to set the direction, not just follow someone else's roadmap. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with no direct reports – your impact comes from what you build and architect, not from managing a team. If you want your fingerprints on the next generation of AI-powered cyber defense at enterprise scale, this is your seat at the table.



What you'll do:

  • Design, build, and ship AI-powered cybersecurity capabilities across threat detection, anomaly identification, identity and access risk analysis, security operations automation, incident response orchestration, and cyber threat intelligence.
  • Architect and stand up multi-agent and agentic AI frameworks that power enterprise cybersecurity use cases, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and knowledge retrieval systems.
  • Lead the engineering and delivery of scalable, cloud-native AI security platforms on Google Cloud using tools like Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
  • Integrate AI capabilities directly into enterprise cybersecurity platforms and services, including Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), secrets management, SIEM, SOAR, GRC, and security telemetry platforms.
  • Set the engineering standards and lifecycle practices for AI platforms – model training pipelines, automated deployment, monitoring, evaluation, drift detection, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD for machine learning workloads.
  • Bake security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI practices into every platform you build, applying Zero Trust principles, Secure-by-Design methods, and defenses against prompt injection, adversarial machine learning threats, data poisoning, model manipulation, and unauthorized access.
  • Partner with cross-functional technical and business teams to turn cybersecurity and business requirements into scalable AI solutions, while shaping architecture, technical direction, and enterprise-wide adoption of modern AI engineering practices.
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.



Experience you'll need to have:

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, building enterprise-scale applications and platforms using Python and modern software development practices.
  • 10+ years of experience designing and operating cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform or a comparable major cloud provider.
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating generative AI and agentic AI systems, including LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity domains such as threat detection, identity and access management, SIEM/SOAR, and security operations, with the ability to translate them into AI-driven engineering solutions.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker) and modern CI/CD and MLOps practices.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence technical direction and enterprise adoption across cross-functional technical and business stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent professional/military experience.



Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with additional enterprise security platforms such as CrowdStrike, Splunk, or comparable SIEM/SOAR and GRC tooling.
  • Background applying Zero Trust and Secure-by-Design principles to AI/ML platform architecture.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Professional certifications, CISSP, or AI/ML-specific credentials).
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading cross-functional technical initiatives at scale.



How you'll work: This role is on-site Monday through Friday and can be based at our Alpharetta, GA cybersecurity tech hub, or our Columbus, OH or Berkeley Heights, NJ offices. description:

About your role:

At Fiserv, we are modernising a high-volume global payment processing platform — moving from a monolithic, batch-driven architecture to an event-driven microservices platform on AWS. This is a ground-up build: Confluent Cloud for event streaming, Aurora PostgreSQL for persistence, Kubernetes for compute, and a modern Java/Kotlin stack throughout.

As a Principal Engineer, you will drive technical delivery strategy across the programme — shaping the architecture patterns teams build on, driving the engineering practices that ensure quality at pace, and making every team around you faster and more effective. You will have influence across both engineering teams and the architecture community, coaching and challenging in equal measure.

You believe AI fundamentally changes how software is built and delivered, and you will drive its adoption as a core part of how teams work — from architecture and design through to code, testing, and delivery.

This is hands-on and outward-facing. You will lead through code, architectural direction, and constructive challenge — ensuring we are building the right things in the right way, and getting to production incrementally rather than in big-bang releases.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the technical delivery strategy — how we decompose, sequence, and integrate work so that teams deliver end-to-end value early and iterate from there.
  • Shape cross-cutting architecture patterns — resilience, event-driven integration, idempotency, observability — and ensure they are adopted consistently across services.
  • Drive architecture decisions toward delivery — challenging over-engineering, unblocking teams when decisions stall, and ensuring designs are practically deliverable.
  • Establish engineering practices that scale: test-driven development, contract testing, continuous integration, trunk-based development, and vertical slicing.
  • Coach and raise the bar across engineers and architects — through pairing, design review, code review, and hands-on demonstration of what good looks like.
  • Apply domain-driven design practically — bounded context integration, aggregates in code, anti-corruption layers — bridging strategy and implementation.
  • Define testing strategy for an event-driven microservices architecture — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end, with clear guidance on where each adds value.
  • Ensure teams are self-sufficient faster — through reusable patterns, service templates, and clear architectural guardrails that accelerate rather than constrain.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • Significant experience as a senior/principal engineer or technical lead delivering distributed systems in production.
  • Deep hands-on experience with modern Java or Kotlin, Spring Boot, and microservices architectures.
  • A track record of shaping technical strategy and architecture direction across multiple teams — not just delivering within one.
  • Strong experience with event-driven architectures — Kafka, event sourcing patterns, eventual consistency, and integration patterns.
  • Practical application of domain-driven design — both strategic (bounded contexts, context mapping) and tactical (aggregates, domain events, repositories).
  • Experience designing for resilience in distributed systems — circuit breakers, retries, timeouts, bulkheads, graceful degradation.
  • Proven ability to coach and influence engineers and architects, shifting culture toward pragmatic engineering excellence.
  • A conviction that AI-assisted engineering is transformative, with experience applying AI tools to accelerate development, testing, or delivery workflows.
  • Experience with iterative delivery — vertical slicing, walking skeletons, integration-first approaches.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Familiarity with payments, financial services, or high-volume transactional domains is a plus but not essential.
  • Exposure to Confluent Cloud, AWS, Kubernetes, GitLab CI, or observability tooling (Dynatrace, distributed tracing) is beneficial.

title: Media Manager - Benelux
description:
About the role:

Are you passionate about building media strategies that connect brands with consumers and translate investment into measurable business impact? As Media Manager, you will lead the development, execution, and continuous optimization of media plans across the Benelux. You will turn global media direction into locally relevant strategies, ensure high-quality briefs and agency output, and create a clear learning agenda that improves effectiveness over time.

You will work closely with Marketing Managers to connect media choices to category and brand priorities, and partner intensively with the Social Manager to build integrated paid, owned, creator, and social plans. As the day-to-day strategic counterpart for the media agency, you will challenge recommendations, safeguard budgets and governance, and bring new ideas, channels, partners, and ways of working into the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. You are comfortable moving between annual planning, campaign briefing, budget tracking, performance reviews, and stakeholder alignment in a complex matrix organization.

The impact you’ll make:

  • Media Strategy & Planning: Own the local media strategy and annual/rolling media plans across brands and categories. Translate business, brand, audience, and campaign objectives into clear channel roles, investment choices, phasing, and measurable outcomes across the consumer decision journey.
  • Global-to-Local Translation: Translate global media strategies, frameworks, partnerships, and campaign guidance into locally relevant plans. Identify where local consumer behavior, media dynamics, retailer ecosystems, or market priorities require adaptation, enrichment, or escalation.
  • Integrated Planning with Social: Work closely with the Social Manager to develop one connected approach across paid media, organic social, creators, influencers, and local content. Ensure media and social plans reinforce each other through aligned audiences, messages, timing, formats, and measurement.
  • Partnership with Marketing Managers: Act as a strategic media partner to Marketing Managers. Help shape campaign objectives, audience choices, launch plans, and investment priorities, while ensuring media plans remain connected to category strategy and commercial goals.
  • Media Agency Leadership: Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for the media agency. Set clear expectations, lead planning and performance discussions, challenge assumptions and recommendations, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery from strategy through activation and reporting.
  • Briefing Quality & Governance: Review and strengthen media briefs before they are submitted to the agency. Ensure briefs contain clear business objectives, audience definitions, communication tasks, success measures, budget parameters, timing, mandatories, and decision rights.
  • Budget Ownership & Optimization: Maintain transparent control of media budgets, commitments, forecasts, and actual spend. Track allocation by brand, campaign, channel, and period; identify risks and opportunities early; and recommend reallocations based on performance, strategic priorities, and market developments.
  • Performance & Effectiveness: Define campaign KPIs with Marketing Managers, the Social Manager, and agency partners. Lead recurring performance reviews, turn data into practical optimization actions, and connect media metrics to brand, consumer, traffic, conversion, and commercial outcomes where data is available.
  • Learning Agenda & Continuous Improvement: Build a structured test-and-learn roadmap covering audiences, creative formats, channels, platforms, retail media, creators, and measurement. Capture learnings, share them across teams, and ensure they influence future briefs and plans.
  • Innovation & New Media Strategies: Proactively identify emerging consumer behaviors, media opportunities, technology, partnerships, and planning approaches. Develop business-relevant pilots and new ideas rather than adopting trends without a clear consumer or commercial rationale.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Marketing, Social, PR, Trade Shopper Marketing, E-commerce, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Data/Analytics, and global media teams to create aligned plans, resolve dependencies, and improve end-to-end execution.
  • Standards, Compliance & Brand Safety: Help ensure media activity follows agreed brand-safety, privacy, procurement, and financial governance requirements, working with the appropriate internal experts and agency partners.

The skills and knowledge you’ll bring:

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Media, Communications, Business, Digital, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Experience: Approximately 5–8 years of relevant experience in media, marketing, digital, or integrated communications, gained on the advertiser and/or agency side. Experience in consumer brands, retail, or a fast-moving international environment is an advantage.
  • Media Expertise: Strong understanding of integrated media planning across video, digital, search, social, retail media, programmatic, audio, out-of-home, and other relevant channels. Able to define the role of each channel rather than manage channels in isolation.
  • Budget & Commercial Acumen: Confident managing substantial budgets, forecasts, purchase commitments, and optimization decisions. Able to balance efficiency, effectiveness, brand-building, and short-term performance objectives.
  • Analytical Capability: Comfortable interpreting agency reports, platform data, campaign KPIs, and research. Able to distinguish signal from noise and translate results into clear decisions and next actions.
  • Briefing & Communication: Excellent at turning business challenges into focused briefs and communicating recommendations clearly to specialists and non-specialists. Confident challenging agencies and senior stakeholders constructively.
  • Collaboration & Influence: A natural connector who builds trust with Marketing Managers, the Social Manager, agencies, global teams, and cross-functional partners. Able to influence without relying on hierarchical authority.
  • Strategic & Execution Balance: Combines curiosity and strategic thinking with strong organization, attention to detail, and a bias for action. Comfortable managing multiple categories and campaigns in parallel.
  • Ways of Working: Proactive, pragmatic, open to experimentation, and disciplined in follow-through. Brings new ideas while respecting brand strategy, available evidence, budgets, and operational realities.
  • Languages: Fluent in English. Dutch is strongly preferred; French is an advantage for effective collaboration across the Benelux.

What success looks like:

  • Media plans are strategically clear, locally relevant, integrated with social, and delivered on time.
  • Marketing Managers experience the Media Manager as a proactive partner who improves briefs, choices, and campaign outcomes.
  • Budgets, commitments, and forecasts are transparent, accurate, and actively optimized throughout the year.
  • The media agency is well directed and constructively challenged, with clear accountability for quality, performance, and learning.
  • Campaign insights lead to documented decisions, scalable best practices, and stronger subsequent plans.
  • New media opportunities are converted into focused pilots with an explicit objective, measurement approach, and recommendation.

What we’ll give you in return:

  • Internationally competitive base salary | benchmarked against global industry and market leaders
  • Sales Incentive Program | rewarding those who dare and achieve more
  • Work from home, commuting and phone allowances | to support your daily commute, home office setup & business connectivity
  • Hybrid working model | effectively combining working from the office & home, depending on team dynamics and personal needs
  • Product Discounts | on all Versuni products which are sold under the Philips brand and our other brands
  • High growth environment | offering exciting learning and career development perspectives beyond your first role
  • Inclusive working culture and family spirit | we embrace our international community & diversity as competitive advantage

Ready to make an impact?

From developing game-changing air fryers to perfecting the art of coffee making, Versuni’s purpose is turning houses into homes — and we’re calling on your talent to bring it to life. Join our global team of 6,000+ passionate individuals, work with world-class brands, and shape the future of home living. We’re ready for you — are you ready for us?

description:

Job Title

Data and AI Portfolio, Director

About your role:
As Director, Data and AI Portfolio, you will own the portfolio that takes our data and AI products from strategy to client value. The portfolio spans 2 arenas for customer facing AI as well as Enterprise AI.

You will decide where we invest and sequence delivery across cross-functional teams. You will also partner with go-to-market and solutions teams to turn pilots into production deployments that clients adopt, pay for and renew. On our most strategic AI engagements, you will be a trusted counterpart to client and partner executives.


What you’ll do:

  • Own the data and AI portfolio across product, engineering, and go-to-market teams. Decide what we fund, sequence, and stop, based on client value, revenue potential, platform leverage, and risk.
  • Run a stage-gated pilot-to-production model for Customer and Enterprise AI use cases. Each gate has clear exit criteria on accuracy, adoption, unit economics and risk sign-off.
  • Partner with Product Management and architecture to shape a reusable platform roadmap covering models, retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, and guardrails, so each new use case ships faster than the last.
  • Partner with go-to-market and solutions teams on launch readiness, packaging and pricing inputs, deal support, and sales enablement, so what we build is sellable and supportable at scale.
  • Serve as the executive delivery lead for strategic client and partner engagements. Run steering committees, set expectations, manage escalations, and turn executive feedback into portfolio decisions.
  • Manage delivery dependencies with model and cloud partners, including roadmap alignment, commercial constraints, and third-party risk.
  • Make responsible AI a delivery standard, in partnership with Risk, Compliance and Legal. Every release includes evaluation, human-in-the-loop design, model risk documentation, and compliance review.
  • Report portfolio performance to senior leadership with a consistent scorecard covering value delivered, adoption, cost to serve, delivery predictability and risk.
  • Build and lead a high-performing team of portfolio managers and product owners, and raise the bar on AI product ownership across the organization.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • 10+ years in product delivery, portfolio, or program leadership. This includes 4+ years leading data or AI portfolios where you owned prioritization and investment trade-offs, not just execution.
  • A proven track record of taking LLM-based products or AI agents from pilot to production at enterprise scale, with measurable outcomes in adoption, cost reduction, or revenue.
  • Fluency in how LLM applications are built and run, including: You can challenge an architecture and a business case with equal confidence in areas including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model and prompt strategy, tool use and agent orchestration, evaluation, and guardrails.
  • Delivery experience across both Customer AI scenarios and Enterprise AI scenarios.
  • Demonstrated partnership with go-to-market and solutions teams, including supporting deals, client pilots and launches for AI or data products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education or experience.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience delivering AI in banking, payments or financial services, including model risk management, third-party risk, and data privacy requirements.
  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Azure and with agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Experience defining AI product unit economics, including inference cost, cost to serve and pricing inputs.

description:

The skills and knowledge you’ll bring:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Well-organized, structured, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong logical thinking and the ability to see the big picture.
  • Curious, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of projects and working independently.

title: Pipeline / Welding Inspector – Subsea Fabrication & Offshore Installation - Contract
description:
Location: Ingleside, Texas
Site: Subsea 7
Employment Type: Contract - Approximatively 12 weeks but can vary
Certification Required: AWS CWI or CSWIP 3.1 / 3.2

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Pipeline / Welding Inspector for a contract assignment in Ingleside, Texas, supporting subsea pipeline fabrication and offshore installation activities.

The ideal candidate will hold a current AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification or CSWIP 3.1/3.2 certification and have previous experience with offshore/subsea pipe fabrication.

The assignment will initially support shipyard/fabrication activities and will extend through loadout, transportation, pipelay vessel activities, and offshore installation.

Key Responsibilities

During the shipyard and fabrication phase, responsibilities will include:

  • Review Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), specifications, and applicable procedures
  • Perform material receiving inspections
  • Verify Material Test Reports (MTRs), material identification, and traceability
  • Witness and review WPS/PQR activities and welder qualification testing
  • Perform fit-up inspections
  • Conduct welding inspections
  • Review NDT documentation and results
  • Perform dimensional inspections
  • Inspect coating and painting activities
  • Inspect riser and spool fabrication
  • Verify anode installation
  • Witness hydrotesting
  • Verify preservation activities
  • Review final inspection and turnover documentation

The inspector will also provide inspection coverage through subsequent project phases, including:

  • Loadout
  • Transportation
  • Pipelay vessel activities
  • Offshore installation
  • Current AWS CWI or CSWIP 3.1/3.2 certification
  • Previous offshore/subsea pipe fabrication experience
  • Strong hands-on experience inspecting pipeline welding and fabrication
  • Experience reviewing WPS/PQRs, welder qualifications, MTRs, NDT documentation, and material traceability
  • Familiarity with coating, dimensional inspection, hydrotesting, preservation, and final documentation
  • Previous exposure to loadout, pipelay vessel, and offshore installation activities is highly desirable
  • Ability to accurately document inspection activities and identify non-conformances
  • Strong understanding of quality control and inspection requirements within a fabrication/shipyard environment.

Benefits:

FlightSafety offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes vacation, sick leave, a 401k match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits.

About FlightSafety International

FlightSafety International is the world’s premier professional aviation training company and supplier of flight simulators, visual systems and displays to commercial, government and military organizations. The company provides training for pilots, technicians and other aviation professionals from 167 countries and independent territories. FlightSafety operates the world’s largest fleet of advanced full-flight simulators and award-winning maintenance training at Learning Centers and training locations in the United States, Canada, France and the United Kingdom.

Purpose of Position

The Flight Instructor delivers exceptional ground and simulator flight instruction in accordance with aviation regulations and FlightSafety Training principles.

Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Conduct pilot ground and simulator training for clients receiving core, specialty or enrichment training courses.
  • Develop and prepare training materials that support training delivery to meet the client needs in accordance with the applicable curriculum.
  • Evaluate and measure trainee progress and recommend for qualification, or additional training.
  • Complete accurate training records specific to each client, aiding their success in achieving the requested objective(s).
  • Identify client training issues and seek assistance prior to execution.
  • Maintain Instructor qualifications in accordance with regulatory requirements.

Minimum Education

  • No requirement.

Minimum Experience

  • Must be able and willing to participate in FlightSafety's DOT Drug and Alcohol testing program
  • An unrestricted ATP certificate, or an ICAO member state Airline Transport Pilot License
  • If no ATP, must meet the requirements of:
  • 14 CFR part 61.153
  • 14 CFR part 61.64 without a Supervised Operating Experience (SOE) limitation.
  • A minimum of one unrestricted PIC type rating;
  • Preferred: FAR Part 135, FAR Part 121, or military training experience;
  • Preferred: 2,500 hours of total flight time

What would be great to have

• Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or Azure DevOps.
• Knowledge of scripting/programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
• Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
• Exposure to shift-left performance testing practices.
• Certifications in performance testing tools (nice to have).

description:

Job Title

AI Engineer

Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.



About your role:

Cyber threats move fast – your models will move faster. As an AI Engineer on our Cyber Engineering team, you'll apply advanced machine learning and statistical techniques to detect, prevent, and respond to cyber threats across an enterprise that processes millions of transactions a day. This isn't a theoretical data science role: you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with cybersecurity engineers, threat analysts, and infrastructure teams to turn massive, messy security telemetry into models and insights that directly protect client data and critical systems. If you want your machine learning work to have immediate, high-stakes, real-world impact on a global fintech's security posture, this is where that happens.



What you’ll do:

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and statistical models for threat detection, anomaly detection, fraud identification, and risk scoring using security event and telemetry data.
  • Engineer robust security data pipelines, including data ingestion, cleansing, feature engineering, and model monitoring, using structured and unstructured cyber data sources (e.g., logs, alerts, network flows, endpoint data).
  • Analyze outputs from security tools and platforms to identify control gaps, policy deviations, and emerging threat patterns, and translate findings into prioritized remediation recommendations.
  • Partner with cybersecurity engineering, Security Operations Center (SOC), and infrastructure teams to embed AI and advanced analytics into security controls, playbooks, and incident response workflows.
  • Conduct model performance evaluations, bias and drift analysis, and continuous tuning to improve detection efficacy while minimizing false positives.
  • Develop clear, consumable visualizations and storytelling artifacts that communicate complex analytic findings and risk scenarios to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Create and maintain documentation for data sources, model architectures, assumptions, validation approaches, and deployment processes in line with internal governance standards.
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.



Experience you’ll need to have:

  • 6+ years of experience in data science or machine learning using programming languages such as Python or R to build and deploy models in production environments, preferably in cybersecurity, fraud, or risk domains.
  • 4+ years of experience working with security-relevant datasets and tools (for example, Security Information and Event Management platforms, endpoint protection, identity and access data, or network telemetry) in an enterprise environment.
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques, including handling class imbalance common in threat and fraud detection use cases.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines that ingest, transform, and operationalize large-scale structured and unstructured data.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent professional/military experience.


Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
  • Hands-on exposure to generative AI, large language models (LLMs), or agentic AI frameworks applied to cybersecurity use cases.
  • Familiarity with SIEM/SOAR platforms, MITRE ATT&CK, or threat intelligence frameworks.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, GIAC, or data science/ML-specific credentials).
  • Experience mentoring junior data scientists or engineers on model development best practices.


How you’ll work:

This role is on-site Monday through Friday and can be based at our Columbus, OH cybersecurity tech hub, or our Alpharetta, GA or Berkeley Heights, NJ offices. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration essential to onboarding, mentorship, and stronger productivity, especially given how closely this role partners with SOC and infrastructure teams.

Minimal travel is expected for this role.

Job Title

Sr Product Manager - Payments

What does a successful Senior Product Manager do at Fiserv?

As a Senior Product Manager at Fiserv focusing on the APAC region, you will lead the go-to-market strategy for delivering scalable, cross-border payment solutions tailored to the needs of multinational merchants operating across the region. Your role involves driving product launches, commercialization, pre-sales consulting, and enabling seamless global commerce for local and international clients.

You will work closely with global product teams, regional sales, marketing, operations, and strategic partners to accelerate market adoption and expand Fiserv's payment capabilities across APAC. In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our clients and the way they conduct commerce.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and execute tailored go-to-market strategies for Fiserv's payment solutions across APAC markets.
  • Collaborate with regional sales, marketing, and operations teams to plan and deliver successful product launches that address local, regional, and international payment needs.
  • Promote the adoption of multi-currency, cross-border payments, and region-specific local payment solutions for multinational clients in the APAC region.
  • Support local sales teams with product knowledge, training, and marketing collateral focused on global payment capabilities suited for APAC markets.
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts for smooth onboarding of multinational merchants requiring payment acceptance across borders.
  • Support the evaluation, onboarding, and commercialization of Alternative Payment Methods (APMs), including digital wallets, real-time payment schemes, and local payment methods to strengthen Fiserv's payment acceptance offering across APAC.
  • Collaborate with payment partners, acquirers, and regional stakeholders to identify market-specific payment preferences and expand local payment coverage for multinational merchants.
  • Define regional product requirements and work closely with global product teams to ensure market needs are incorporated into the product roadmap.
  • Monitor market response, gather merchant feedback, and refine GTM strategies to better serve multinational clients in APAC.
  • Stay informed about regional regulations, emerging payment technologies, and competitive trends affecting international commerce.
  • Act as a bridge between global product development and regional markets, translating customer and market needs into effective commercialization and GTM initiatives.

What You Will Need To Have

  • 12+ years of experience in product management, payments, solution consulting, implementation, sales engineering, or commercialization roles.
  • 10+ years of experience within payments, merchant acquiring, payment processing, payment gateways, digital commerce, or related financial technology industries.
  • Deep understanding of cross-border payments, multi-currency processing, authorization optimization, and merchant payment acceptance.
  • Experience launching and commercializing payment products across multiple APAC markets.
  • Strong consultative and strategic sales support capabilities with the ability to influence stakeholders across commercial, product, and operational teams.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure, optimize, and refine go-to-market initiatives.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams in a matrixed and global environment.

What Would Be Great To Have

  • Experience with Alternative Payment Methods (APMs), including digital wallets, local payment methods, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), or real-time payment schemes.

  • Familiarity with APAC payment ecosystems, local payment schemes, and regional regulatory requirements.
