title: Pipeline / Welding Inspector – Subsea Fabrication & Offshore Installation (Ingleside) - Contract
description:
Location: Ingleside, Texas
Site: Subsea 7
Employment Type: Contract - Approximatively 12 weeks but can vary
Certification Required: AWS CWI or CSWIP 3.1 / 3.2

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Pipeline / Welding Inspector for a contract assignment in Ingleside, Texas, supporting subsea pipeline fabrication and offshore installation activities.

The ideal candidate will hold a current AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification or CSWIP 3.1/3.2 certification and have previous experience with offshore/subsea pipe fabrication.

The assignment will initially support shipyard/fabrication activities and will extend through loadout, transportation, pipelay vessel activities, and offshore installation.

Key Responsibilities

During the shipyard and fabrication phase, responsibilities will include:

  • Review Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), specifications, and applicable procedures
  • Perform material receiving inspections
  • Verify Material Test Reports (MTRs), material identification, and traceability
  • Witness and review WPS/PQR activities and welder qualification testing
  • Perform fit-up inspections
  • Conduct welding inspections
  • Review NDT documentation and results
  • Perform dimensional inspections
  • Inspect coating and painting activities
  • Inspect riser and spool fabrication
  • Verify anode installation
  • Witness hydrotesting
  • Verify preservation activities
  • Review final inspection and turnover documentation

The inspector will also provide inspection coverage through subsequent project phases, including:

  • Loadout
  • Transportation
  • Pipelay vessel activities
  • Offshore installation
  • Current AWS CWI or CSWIP 3.1/3.2 certification
  • Previous offshore/subsea pipe fabrication experience
  • Strong hands-on experience inspecting pipeline welding and fabrication
  • Experience reviewing WPS/PQRs, welder qualifications, MTRs, NDT documentation, and material traceability
  • Familiarity with coating, dimensional inspection, hydrotesting, preservation, and final documentation
  • Previous exposure to loadout, pipelay vessel, and offshore installation activities is highly desirable
  • Ability to accurately document inspection activities and identify non-conformances
  • Strong understanding of quality control and inspection requirements within a fabrication/shipyard environment.

Job Title

Android Application Framework Developer - Device Engineering

About Your Role

Clover is a global leader in point-of-sale (POS) platforms powering millions of small businesses worldwide with integrated hardware, software, and secure payment solutions. We are seeking a highly energized, disciplined, and tech-passionate Android Application Framework Developer to join our Device Engineering team in Sunnyvale, CA. In this high-impact systems role, you will help build, certify, and operate Clover’s next-generation Android-based smart terminal devices. You will bridge the gap between high-level Android applications and low-level hardware, taking direct ownership of core Android framework services, POS peripheral integration, and hardware communication architectures. If you thrive in an agile environment alongside like-minded, highly skilled engineers and are excited about building software that interacts directly with physical devices, we want to talk to you!


What You Will Do

  • Android Framework & Hardware Integration: Design and build Android application framework services and background daemons that directly interface with external hardware peripherals, payment kernels, and low-level microcontrollers.
  • Peripheral Architecture & Vendor SDKs: Integrate POS vendor SDKs and build robust communication pipelines for external hardware including receipt printers, cash drawers, barcode scanners, and weighing scales.
  • USB & Network Protocol Management: Manage Android USB OTG Host APIs, handle USB attach/detach events, manage dynamic USB hardware permissions, and implement socket programming for network-connected peripherals.
  • System Infrastructure & Data Sync: Add new capabilities to core platform infrastructure and services, ensuring low-latency, sub-second data synchronization and communication across diverse terminal device types.
  • Defect Triage & Troubleshooting: Investigate, isolate, and resolve complex system integration issues, OS regressions, and hardware peripheral bugs across production devices.
  • Cross-Functional Certification & Product Alignment: Partner with product management to refine technical specifications and collaborate directly with international certification teams and hardware test labs.
  • Production Reliability: Participate in a regular on-call rotation to provide production support and maintain fleet-wide device health.
  • AI-First Engineering: Apply an AI-first mindset, leveraging AI-powered development tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and coding agents) to accelerate framework development, optimize infrastructure, and streamline root-cause analysis.

What You Need to Have

  • Experience & Mindset: 2+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on Android platform architecture, framework design, and a genuine eagerness to learn and innovate in POS device engineering.
  • Android Application & Framework Depth: Hands-on experience developing native Android applications and background services in Kotlin and Java, with proven experience communicating with external physical hardware.
  • USB & Networking Protocols: Practical proficiency with Android USB Host APIs (USB OTG), managing USB device permissions/events, and socket programming for network IP printers and hardware endpoints.
  • AOSP Language Proficiency: Proficiency in at least two major languages used in the Android stack (Kotlin, Java, C, or C++).
  • UI & Performance Optimization: Experience developing clean, performant Android UIs adapted for custom terminal screen sizes and hardware constraints.
  • Developer Tooling & Revision Control: Strong working knowledge of version control and code review tools, including Git and Gerrit.
  • Security & Cryptography Basics: Broad understanding of platform security protocols, PKI, digital certificates, encryption/decryption, and hardware-level security (HSM).
  • AI-First Fluency: Demonstrated experience leveraging AI coding tools and LLM assistants for code generation, refactoring, and debugging.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • AOSP (Android Open Source Project) Customization: Hands-on experience modifying AOSP, building custom Android system services, or working within frameworks/base/.
  • POS & Hardware Peripheral Vendor SDKs: Prior experience integrating third-party vendor SDKs for Point of Sale (POS), retail, or kiosk hardware.
  • Embedded Systems & RTOS: Familiarity with low-level microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M/R), embedded C development, or Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) for inter-CPU communication protocols (SPI, UART, CAN).

How you’ll work:

  • This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.
  • This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.

• Experience with cloud, containerization, and orchestration technologies (Docker, PCF, Kubernetes).

description:

Principal Engineer - Commerce Hub

About your role:

At Fiserv, we are modernising a high-volume global payment processing platform — moving from a monolithic, batch-driven architecture to an event-driven microservices platform on AWS. This is a ground-up build: Confluent Cloud for event streaming, Aurora PostgreSQL for persistence, Kubernetes for compute, and a modern Java/Kotlin stack throughout.

As a Principal Engineer, you will drive technical delivery strategy across the programme — shaping the architecture patterns teams build on, driving the engineering practices that ensure quality at pace, and making every team around you faster and more effective. You will have influence across both engineering teams and the architecture community, coaching and challenging in equal measure.

You believe AI fundamentally changes how software is built and delivered, and you will drive its adoption as a core part of how teams work — from architecture and design through to code, testing, and delivery.

This is hands-on and outward-facing. You will lead through code, architectural direction, and constructive challenge — ensuring we are building the right things in the right way, and getting to production incrementally rather than in big-bang releases.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the technical delivery strategy — how we decompose, sequence, and integrate work so that teams deliver end-to-end value early and iterate from there.
  • Shape cross-cutting architecture patterns — resilience, event-driven integration, idempotency, observability — and ensure they are adopted consistently across services.
  • Drive architecture decisions toward delivery — challenging over-engineering, unblocking teams when decisions stall, and ensuring designs are practically deliverable.

  • Coach and raise the bar across engineers and architects — through pairing, design review, code review, and hands-on demonstration of what good looks like.
  • Apply domain-driven design practically — bounded context integration, aggregates in code, anti-corruption layers — bridging strategy and implementation.
  • Define testing strategy for an event-driven microservices architecture — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end, with clear guidance on where each adds value.
  • Ensure teams are self-sufficient faster — through reusable patterns, service templates, and clear architectural guardrails that accelerate rather than constrain.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • Significant experience as a senior/principal engineer or technical lead delivering distributed systems in production.

  • Strong experience with event-driven architectures — Kafka, event sourcing patterns, eventual consistency, and integration patterns.
  • Practical application of domain-driven design — both strategic (bounded contexts, context mapping) and tactical (aggregates, domain events, repositories).

title: JSE Mission Modeler
description:
About FlightSafety International

FlightSafety International is the world’s premier professional aviation training company and supplier of flight simulators, visual systems and displays to commercial, government and military organizations. The company provides training for pilots, technicians and other aviation professionals from 167 countries and independent territories. FlightSafety operates the world’s largest fleet of advanced full-flight simulators and award-winning maintenance training at Learning Centers and training locations in the United States, Canada, France and the United Kingdom.

Position Overview

FlightSafety Defense Corporation is gearing to become a recognized integration partner and solution provider for the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Navy in the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE) and Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS) ecosystem. The JSE Mission Modeler is a key contributor within the JSE/SCARS line of efforts, responsible for designing, building, and executing military mission scenarios that support large-force virtual training and mission rehearsal within the JSE Technical Baseline (JTB).

This role directly supports FSI Defense's pursuit of modular and scalable simulation architectures capable of supporting 100+ player exercises within a shared synthetic battlespace. The right candidate brings hands-on experience with military scenario authoring, constructive simulation frameworks, and the operational knowledge needed to produce tactically credible training events across multiple classification levels and platform types.

Key Responsibilities

The JSE Mission Modeler designs and develops mission scenarios for large-force virtual training exercises within the JSE synthetic battlespace. This includes building scenario content that integrates blue air, red air, constructive forces, and environmental conditions using JSE-compatible tools, behavior scripts, and constructive simulation frameworks.

The Mission Modeler authors and maintains scenario behavior files, Lua-based launching scripts, mission planning configurations, and scenario control logic in accordance with JSE Platform Package (JPP) standards. The role requires close coordination with JSE GRID services — including entity state management, sensor services, weapon interactions, and line-of-sight services — to produce high-fidelity, repeatable training events.

The JSE Mission Modeler works with Government program offices, aircrew subject matter experts (SMEs), and simulation engineers to translate operational training requirements into executable synthetic environment scenarios. This includes supporting scenario validation events at JSE facilities, participating in test events at government sites such as JITTC-E (Elmendorf AFB), NAWDC (Fallon NAS), and Digital Test and Training Range (DTTR) locations, and supporting debrief analysis.

The role supports the development and maintenance of scenario libraries across multiple mission profiles, platform types, and force ratios, with particular attention to scalability for multi-site training environments and secure multi-level security (MLS) operations across networks. The Mission Modeler also contributes to scenario documentation, supports Requirements Verification Report (RVR) activities, and maintains traceability between scenario design artifacts and applicable JSE and SCARS standards.

Travel to Government test events, contractor facilities, and operational training sites is anticipated throughout the year.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in aerospace engineering, systems engineering, operations research, computer science, or a closely related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred
  • 5 or more years of experience in military mission scenario development, constructive simulation, or distributed synthetic environment operations in a DoD context
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with military scenario authoring tools and constructive simulation frameworks (e.g., AFSIM, JSAF, EADSIM, OneSAF, NGTS, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with distributed simulation protocols including HLA, DIS, or TENA, and experience connecting scenario entities to a networked synthetic environment
  • Understanding of JSE architecture, GRID services, and the JSE Platform Package (JPP) structure, including behavior files, Lua scripting, and entity state message formats
  • Operational knowledge of U.S. Air Force or U.S. Navy aviation tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), sufficient to author tactically credible training scenarios
  • Experience supporting large-force exercises (LFEs) or virtual training events with 50 or more players in a live, virtual, or constructive (LVC) environment
  • Strong technical writing and communication skills, with experience producing scenario documentation, test plans, and after-action reports (AARs)
  • Active Secret clearance; ability to obtain Top Secret/SCI clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience working within the JSE ecosystem, including familiarity with GRID services, the Government Simulation Interface (GSI) SDK, and JSE Technical Baseline (JTB) components
  • Experience with multi-level security (MLS) simulation environments and cross-domain scenario operations
  • Familiarity with SCARS Increment 5 standards, including the SCARS Architecture Standard and DevSecOps Process Standard
  • Experience with the Weapon System Trainer Common Environment (WSCE) and standard munitions modeling workflows
  • Proficiency in Lua, Python, or C++ for scenario scripting, automation, and data analysis
  • Familiarity with MBSE methodologies and SysML-based modeling tools used in JSE program documentation
  • Prior experience supporting Government program offices, including AFLCMC, PMA-205, or JSE Program Office activities
  • Experience with debrief system integration and training effectiveness analysis

Why This Role

The JSE Mission Modeler sits at the intersection of operational military knowledge and advanced simulation engineering — a combination that is rare and highly valued in the JSE ecosystem. This individual will directly shape the quality and tactical fidelity of training scenarios that FSI Defense delivers as part of the DIU All Players initiative and future JSE-connected programs. As FSI Defense establishes itself as a recognized integration partner for the USAF and Navy, the Mission Modeler will have early visibility into some of the most strategically significant training system programs in the Department of Defense.

description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

Job Title

Business Analyst

About your role:

Reporting to the Programme Director and/or Programme Manager, the role of Business Analyst is to support client implementations, conversions and migration initiatives by gathering, analysing and documenting business and functional requirements in line with programme objectives and delivery needs.

Working closely with clients, internal Fiserv teams and third-party partners, the Business Analyst plays a key role in ensuring that business needs are clearly understood, translated into structured functional requirements and aligned to solution capabilities, operational processes and target-state outcomes.

The Business Analyst is responsible for supporting analysis activities across the full project lifecycle, from initial requirements definition and current-state assessment through functional documentation, testing support, go-live readiness and transition to BAU. The role acts as a critical link between business stakeholders, subject matter experts, implementation teams, product, technology and testing teams to help ensure that solutions are delivered in line with business, operational and technical requirements.

Within this context, the role requires a solid understanding of issuing and card-processing environments, including client servicing, operational processes and the impacts of migrating from legacy platforms to modern target solutions.

What you’ll do:

  • Leading business and functional requirements discussions with clients, internal stakeholders and subject matter experts to gather, validate and document project needs.

  • Analysing current-state and target-state processes to identify functional gaps, operational impacts, dependencies and areas requiring clarification or design decisions.

  • Defining and documenting business requirements, functional requirements, process flows, business rules, user stories and other supporting analysis artefacts.

  • Translating business needs into clear, structured and actionable functional requirements for implementation, product, technology and testing teams.

  • Supporting solution definition activities by working closely with SMEs, implementation teams, product teams and technical teams to assess options and recommend appropriate functional approaches.

  • Producing and maintaining analysis documentation across the project lifecycle, including requirements packs, functional specifications, gap analysis, decision logs and process documentation.

  • Developing and maintaining requirements traceability to ensure approved requirements, changes and decisions are tracked and aligned to delivery outcomes.

  • Supporting the documentation of the overall functional approach, including impacts to client processes, operational models, controls and target-state solution design.

  • Identifying, analysing, researching and resolving functional queries raised by internal teams, clients and third-party partners.

  • Supporting impact assessments related to process changes, regulatory and compliance requirements, operational readiness and implementation activities.

  • Working closely with issuing, card-processing and operational stakeholders to ensure that business priorities, processing requirements and client expectations are clearly understood and reflected in the solution.

  • Supporting readiness activities by ensuring that requirements, process impacts, decisions and functional dependencies are clearly understood by all relevant stakeholders.

  • Acting as a key liaison between business stakeholders and delivery teams throughout the implementation lifecycle, ensuring clear communication and alignment at all stages.

Execution & Controls

  • Managing and maintaining business analysis deliverables in accordance with established Fiserv governance, standards and project methodology.

  • Supporting the planning, prioritisation and delivery of business analysis activities in line with project milestones, implementation phases and delivery timelines.

  • Ensuring that requirements are reviewed, validated, approved and baselined in line with agreed governance processes.

  • Tracking requirement changes, open points, assumptions, dependencies and key decisions throughout the lifecycle of the project.

  • Supporting the creation and maintenance of functional documentation required for implementation, testing, readiness and go-live activities.

  • Working with implementation, product, technology and testing teams to ensure requirements are fully understood and correctly translated into solution design and delivery outputs.

  • Supporting testing activities by reviewing test scenarios, validating coverage against requirements and assisting with defect analysis, functional clarifications and issue resolution.

  • Supporting user acceptance testing, operational readiness assessments and go-live preparation from a functional and business process perspective.

  • Participating in governance meetings, status reviews, workshops and working sessions to provide updates on analysis progress, requirement status, key decisions and unresolved issues.

  • Escalating risks, issues, requirement gaps or delivery concerns to the appropriate stakeholders in a timely and structured manner.

  • Maintaining clear and consistent communication with clients, internal teams and third parties on requirements, impacts, decisions and functional changes.

  • Supporting implementation events and critical project milestones by providing functional expertise and analysis support where required.

Closeout & Transition

  • Confirming that business and functional requirements have been delivered, validated and transitioned appropriately into implementation, testing, warranty and BAU support processes.

  • Supporting the completion of final documentation and ensuring that approved requirements, decisions and analysis artefacts are archived appropriately.

  • Assisting with the review of implementation outcomes, requirement coverage, defects and lessons learned to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Ensuring that outstanding functional queries, requirement gaps or follow-up actions are tracked through to closure or transitioned appropriately into warranty and BAU support processes.

  • Contributing to post-implementation reviews and Lessons Learned activities where applicable.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with professional proficiency in both English and Italian.

  • Working knowledge of issuing, card-processing and payments operations, with an understanding of how business requirements translate into processing and operational outcomes.

  • Subject Matter Expert / Business Analyst experience in one or more of the following areas strongly preferred: Regulatory, Compliance, Payment Schemes, Card Processing, Customer Correspondence, Fulfillment, Collections, Risk/Fraud, Disputes, Chargebacks, Retrievals, Testing, Consumer Finance, Credit Cards, Loans, Debit Cards and Retail Cards.

  • Significant proven experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, functional analysis or solution analysis roles, within the Financial Services industry, in the Cards and Payments sector; experience in card and/or payment processing environments is preferred (6-10 years).

  • Proven experience supporting and/or leading business analysis activities for medium to large client-facing implementations, conversions or migration initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and workstreams.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Business Analysis certification or equivalent professional training preferred.

  • Experience in issuing, card-processing or broader consumer finance environments strongly preferred.

  • Experience supporting migrations from legacy platforms to modern processing platforms.

  • Experience working on multi-country programmes and complex client delivery initiatives.

  • Exposure to regulatory, operational or processing change initiatives within issuing environments preferred.

Salary starting at €60,300 - negotiable depending on experience

Within Fiserv, this role supports merchant acquiring risk activities across Credit & Risk (C&R) functions that help protect the business while enabling growth. The Director Credit Risk I leads a team responsible for oversight of credit risk practices across merchant onboarding, portfolio monitoring, exposure management, and related risk controls. This role partners across operations, underwriting, fraud, finance, and business leadership to drive sound risk decisions and support portfolio performance.

What you’ll do

  • Lead credit risk activities across merchant acquiring functions within Credit & Risk (C&R).
  • Oversee credit underwriting, portfolio monitoring, exposure management, and risk control practices.
  • Establish, implement, and refine credit risk frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned with business objectives and risk appetite.
  • Review portfolio trends, merchant performance, loss indicators, and concentration risks to support informed risk decisions.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate merchant risk, escalations, exceptions, and ongoing account performance.
  • Support governance, audit readiness, reporting, and control execution for credit risk operations.
  • Use portfolio analytics and reporting insights to identify opportunities for process improvement and risk mitigation.
  • Guide the team in executing risk assessments, approvals, reviews, and issue resolution across merchant acquiring portfolios.
  • Perform other responsibilities as required; this list is not exhaustive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience you’ll need

18+ years of progressive leadership experience in credit risk, merchant acquiring, payments, or financial services, with demonstrated success across the following areas:

  • Enterprise leadership of merchant credit risk, spanning underwriting, portfolio strategy, exposure management, reserves, and loss mitigation.
  • Design and execution of credit risk strategy, governance frameworks, policies, controls, and risk appetite aligned with commercial objectives.
  • Oversight of complex, large-scale portfolios, including high-risk merchant segments, concentration risk, material exposures, and emerging risk.
  • Executive decision-making informed by merchant financials, processing performance, chargeback trends, portfolio analytics, and forward-looking risk indicators.
  • Leadership of regulatory examinations, audits, governance forums, control environments, and senior-level risk reporting.
  • Influence across business, finance, underwriting, fraud, operations, compliance, and technology to balance growth, customer outcomes, and risk.
  • Development of high-performing teams and leadership capability within a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, risk management, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have

  • Leadership experience within a global merchant acquiring, payments, or financial services organization.
  • Deep knowledge of card network requirements, regulatory expectations, and leading industry risk practices.
  • Strategic application of advanced analytics, risk models, automation, and decisioning capabilities to strengthen portfolio performance.
  • Oversight of high-risk industries, complex ownership structures, multinational merchants, or large strategic accounts.
  • Credibility presenting material exposures, portfolio trends, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and governance committees.
  • Advanced degree or relevant professional certification in finance, risk, or a related discipline.

About your role:

SAP PO BTP Integration Suite Senior Developer leads the design, development, migration, and support of enterprise integration solutions across SAP and non-SAP platforms. You will work with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, application teams, and platform teams to build secure, scalable, and maintainable integrations. This role matters because it enables reliable data exchange, supports modernization from SAP Process Orchestration (PO) to SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) Integration Suite, and improves operational stability across critical business systems.


What you'll do:


  • Design, develop, test, and deploy integration solutions using SAP BTP Integration Suite, including Cloud Integration and Cloud Platform Integration (CPI).
  • Develop and maintain integration flows, application programming interfaces (APIs), event-driven integrations, and file-based interfaces across SAP and third-party systems.
  • Implement integrations using Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) web services, Open Data Protocol (OData) services, Intermediate Document (IDoc), Remote Function Call (RFC), Business Application Programming Interface (BAPI), Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP), Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS), and message queue technologies.
  • Build complex message mappings using graphical mapping, Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformations (XSLT), XML Path Language (XPath), and Groovy scripting.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate functional and technical needs into integration designs and delivery plans.
  • Define integration patterns, standards, reusable frameworks, and technical design approaches that improve consistency, scalability, and supportability.

Job Title

Data Architect

About your role:

At Fiserv, we are dedicated to transforming financial services technology to benefit our clients. As an Architect – Data Products, you will define and lead the architecture of scalable, secure, and reliable data products that power analytics, reporting, and data delivery for our clients. You will partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to design modern cloud data platforms, set technical standards, and ensure our data products meet quality, performance, and SLA commitments.

What you’ll do:

  • Define the end-to-end architecture for data products, including ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and delivery on cloud data platforms.
  • Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to translate requirements into data models, technical designs, and delivery roadmaps.
  • Design and oversee scalable batch and streaming pipelines using Databricks, Spark, and Azure data services.
  • Design AI-ready data products and platform capabilities that support machine learning and generative AI use cases, including feature engineering, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines.
  • Establish standards for data quality, security, access control, lineage, and metadata management across data products.
  • Lead platform modernization and migration initiatives, ensuring client data delivery meets performance and SLA commitments.
  • Conduct architecture and design reviews, and drive engineering best practices, automation (including AI-assisted development), and release quality controls.
  • Mentor data engineers and provide technical guidance to cross-functional and vendor teams.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or software development
  • 5+ years of experience designing and building data platforms or data products at enterprise scale
  • 4+ years of experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and Delta Lake or similar lakehouse technologies
  • 4+ years of experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP data services
  • 4+ years of experience with SQL, Python or Scala, and data modeling (dimensional, relational, and lakehouse)
  • 3+ years of experience with data governance, security, and access control practices
  • 3+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Agile methodologies
  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or an equivalent combination of education, work, and/or military experience.

  • Experience in the financial services industry

About your role:

Every cybersecurity initiative at Fiserv passes through architecture, and our team is small, selective, and highly influential by design. As a Cybersecurity Architect, you'll help design and govern the security architecture that protects a company from processing millions of transactions a day, working alongside a tight-knit group of specialists across identity, network, cloud, and AI. You'll bring real-world architectural judgment, not just theory, to some of the most consequential security decisions in fintech.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, review, and govern enterprise cybersecurity architecture across identity and access management, network, cloud, and AI/automation domains.

  • Produce formal architecture documentation, including Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and Architecture Requirement Documents (ARDs), that translate business needs into secure, scalable designs.

  • Partner with engineering teams to translate architectural concepts into clear, actionable engineering specifications.

description:

Job Title

Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Monitoramento e Observabilidade

O que faz um Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Monitoramento e Observabilidade de sucesso na Fiserv?

Um Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Monitoramento e Observabilidade de sucesso na Fiserv impulsiona a confiabilidade operacional por meio de uma estratégia robusta de observabilidade e monitoramento em ambientes críticos. Esta posição transforma necessidades técnicas e operacionais em soluções escaláveis que aumentam a visibilidade, disponibilidade e desempenho de plataformas híbridas. Trabalha em colaboração com equipes de infraestrutura, aplicações, operações e arquitetura para implementar capacidades de observabilidade do zero e estabilizá-las com excelência operacional. Procuramos uma pessoa com visão técnica, abordagem consultiva e capacidade para liderar iniciativas complexas em um ambiente FinTech dinâmico.

O que você fará:

  • Avaliar o ambiente atual de monitoramento e observabilidade para identificar lacunas, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria em plataformas mainframe e cloud.
  • Projetar arquiteturas de referência, padrões de instrumentação e modelos de eventos, métricas, logs, traces, dashboards e alertas.
  • Liderar a implementação end-to-end de capacidades de observabilidade, incluindo integrações, automações, governança técnica e transição para operações.
  • Definir indicadores operacionais e técnicos, critérios de alerta, SLI/SLO e mecanismos para reduzir ruído e antecipar falhas.
  • Criar dashboards executivos e operacionais para acompanhar saúde, disponibilidade, capacidade, desempenho e tendências.
  • Integrar a observabilidade aos processos de incidentes, problemas e mudanças para fortalecer a análise de causa raiz e a melhoria contínua.
  • Colaborar com equipes de mainframe, cloud, redes, segurança, SRE, arquitetura e operações para garantir uma execução alinhada e sustentável.
  • Documentar padrões, runbooks, procedimentos de suporte e materiais de transferência de conhecimento.

O que você precisa:

  • Experiência em observabilidade, monitoramento de infraestrutura, APM, análise de logs e gerenciamento de eventos em ambientes críticos.
  • Experiência no desenho e implementação de dashboards, alertas acionáveis, métricas, logs, traces, SLI/SLO e health checks.
  • Experiência em plataformas híbridas envolvendo mainframe e cloud, incluindo z/OS, JCL, processamento batch, eventos operacionais, monitoramento de subsistemas e serviços distribuídos.
  • Experiência em automação com Python, integração via APIs REST/HTTPS, troubleshooting técnico e operação de serviços em Linux e/ou Windows Server. Conhecimento em autenticação, certificados, proxy, DNS e conectividade corporativa.
  • Experiência na integração com plataformas ITSM (preferencialmente ServiceNow), bancos de dados relacionais, SQL e práticas de suporte operacional em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.
  • Inglês avançado, oral e escrito.

Qualificações desejáveis:

  • Experiência na implementação de práticas de observabilidade do zero, cobrindo desenho, integração, go-live e estabilização.
  • Experiência com PostgreSQL, SQL, retenção de dados, auditoria e processamento de dados operacionais.
  • Experiência com ServiceNow ou plataformas equivalentes para integração de incidentes, eventos e automações.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, operações 24x7 e modelos de suporte com alta exigência de disponibilidade.
  • Experiência com frameworks e certificações relacionadas a Cloud, SRE, ITIL, Observabilidade ou tecnologias Mainframe.
  • Experiência aplicando técnicas de redução de alert fatigue, detecção de anomalias, definição de thresholds e monitoramento proativo.

Nossa Cultura:

Nossa aspiração é mover dinheiro e informações de uma forma que mova o mundo. Nosso objetivo é entregar valor superior aos nossos clientes por meio de tecnologia de ponta, inovação direcionada e excelência em tudo o que fazemos.

Nossos valores orientam a forma como tomamos decisões e cumprimos nossos compromissos com nossos clientes e entre nós. Eles expressam aquilo que valorizamos e consideramos importante. Guiam nossas decisões diárias e sustentam a cultura na qual queremos trabalhar.

Nossa cultura, baseada no orgulho coletivo e no reconhecimento das conquistas de cada colaborador, é visível todos os dias por meio das nossas publicações #FISVProud nas redes sociais.

title: Ecommerce Data Scientist
description:
About the role:

The ecommerce landscape is evolving rapidly, requiring strong analytical capabilities to turn data into actionable insights. At Versuni, we believe data plays a critical role in driving better decisions, improving performance, and enabling sustainable growth.

We are looking for a driven and analytical Data Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will take ownership of key analytical and data science initiatives, applying statistical techniques and machine learning to solve business problems and influence decision-making. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and play a key role in delivering impactful data solutions.

If you enjoy owning problems end-to-end, uncovering insights, and driving business impact through data, this role is for you.

The impact you’ll make:

Data Analysis & Problem Solving:

  • Own end-to-end analytical projects, from problem definition to delivery of insights and recommendations.
  • Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches and measurable outputs.
  • Perform deep-dive analyses to identify trends, drivers, and opportunities.

Data Visualization & Storytelling

  • Design and build dashboards and reports (e.g., Power BI) that enable stakeholders to track and act on key metrics.
  • Communicate insights clearly through compelling visualizations and narratives that drive decisions.

Machine Learning & Modelling

  • Develop, deploy, and refine predictive models (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, forecasting).
  • Evaluate model performance and iterate to improve accuracy and business relevance.
  • Take ownership of models in production, including monitoring and maintenance.

Data Collection, Preparation & Management

  • Own data collection and preparation processes, ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability.
  • Work with large datasets and shape them into usable formats for analysis and modelling.

Business Collaboration

  • Partner closely with teams such as Ecommerce, Marketing, Product, and Operations to identify opportunities and deliver data-driven solutions.
  • Analyse ecommerce performance across the funnel (traffic, conversion, retention, revenue) to drive optimization.
  • Translate analytical outputs into actionable recommendations that influence business outcomes.

Tools & Technologies

  • Use Python, R, SQL, and visualization tools to deliver scalable analytical solutions.
  • Work with cloud and data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Databricks) to operationalize analyses.

Continuous Improvement

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve data processes, models, and methodologies.
  • Stay current with emerging tools and techniques in data science.

The skills and knowledge you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or related field.
  • 5+ years’ experience in data science, ecommerce analytics, or similar roles; in global/multi-market environments preferred.
  • Proven ability to independently own and deliver analytical or data science projects.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis and modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to query large, complex datasets.
  • Experience in machine learning, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and data mining.
  • Knowledge of Databricks for data engineering is a plus
  • Experience in data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate business needs into data solutions
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders through data.

What we’ll give you in return:

  • Internationally competitive base salary | benchmarked against global industry and market leaders
  • Performance-based Annual Incentive Program | rewarding those who dare and achieve more
  • Top of the market pension scheme | with higher-than-average company contributions
  • Work from home, commuting and phone allowances | to support your daily commute, home office setup & business connectivity
  • Balanced office-based working | With a strong focus on in-office collaboration, we offer flexibility to work from home based on team needs and individual circumstances.
  • Work from abroad | Up to 30 days per year.
  • Structured holiday policy | Includes defined care days, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, and a capped option to purchase additional leave days annually.

title: SRE Lead
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

SRE Lead

About your role:

At Fiserv, we are modernising a high-volume global payment processing platform — migrating from a legacy monolithic PL/SQL core to a cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture on AWS. This is a ground-up build across different business domains. Confluent Cloud for event streaming, Aurora PostgreSQL for persistence, EKS (Kubernetes) for compute, and a modern Java/Quarkus stack throughout.

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the production readiness and operational health of the new platform as services go live. You will ensure that what we build is observable, resilient, and operable — bridging the gap between engineering teams building services and the reality of running a payment platform that processes millions of transactions daily. You will define what production-ready means, ensure teams meet that bar, and build the tooling and practices that keep the platform healthy.

This is a particularly critical role during modernisation — new microservices will go live alongside the legacy system, with traffic migrating incrementally via feature flags and canary deployments (Argo Rollouts). You will ensure we can operate both with confidence, understand system behavior under load, and detect and respond to issues before they impact clients.

What you’ll do:

  • Define and own production readiness standards — what every service must have before going live: observability, SLOs, runbooks, resource limits, graceful degradation and policy compliance.
  • Build and maintain observability — owning the Dynatrace APM deployment, Splunk log pipelines via Fluent Bit, and Prometheus metrics across the platform. Ensuring distributed tracing, structured logging, and dashboards give clear visibility into system health across the event-driven pipeline.
  • Define and implement SLIs/SLOs — working with engineering teams and stakeholders to define meaningful service level indicators and objectives, and building the measurement infrastructure.
  • Own incident response practices — defining how we detect, respond to, and learn from production issues. Building the culture of blameless post-mortems and reliability improvement.
  • Drive resilience engineering — chaos testing, failover validation, load testing, and ensuring the platform degrades gracefully under stress rather than failing catastrophically.
  • Support engineering teams on operability — reviewing designs for operational concerns, advising on retry strategies, timeout tuning, circuit breaker configuration, and back-pressure handling.
  • Manage the transition from legacy to new — ensuring we can operate both systems during migration, with clear visibility into traffic routing, parity, and system behaviour during cutovers.
  • Automate operational toil — building tooling that reduces manual intervention, improves deployment confidence, and makes the platform easier to operate at scale.
  • Capacity planning — understanding traffic patterns, growth trajectories, and ensuring the platform is provisioned appropriately for both normal and peak load.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • Experience in SRE, production engineering, or operations for high-volume distributed systems — you have kept critical systems running and improved their reliability.
  • Strong hands-on skills with observability platforms — distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), metrics (Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent), structured logging, and APM tools (Dynatrace, Datadog, or similar).
  • Experience defining and measuring SLIs/SLOs and using them to drive engineering decisions.
  • Understanding of resilience patterns in distributed systems — circuit breakers, retries, timeouts, bulkheads, back-pressure — and how to validate they work.
  • Experience with load and performance testing — defining realistic scenarios, running at scale, and interpreting results to identify bottlenecks.
  • Comfort with cloud infrastructure — AWS services, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with event-driven systems — Kafka, message-based architectures, and the operational challenges they bring (lag monitoring, consumer group management, partition rebalancing).
  • A mindset of enabling engineering teams rather than gatekeeping — you set standards and build tooling, not approve deployments.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Dynatrace or equivalent APM — distributed tracing, anomaly detection, SLO tracking, and alerting. Dynatrace experience is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with payments, financial services, or high-volume transactional domains is a plus but not essential.
  • Exposure to incident management tooling, on-call practices, or chaos engineering frameworks is beneficial.

About your role:
At Fiserv, we are transforming our payment platforms to deliver modern, scalable, resilient, and secure digital payment experiences. As a Software Development Engineering - Advisor II, you will play a key technical role in the SnapPay modernization program, designing and delivering cloud-native services and APIs that support critical payment capabilities.

You will work closely with product, architecture, engineering, QA, security, and infrastructure teams to translate business capabilities into well-defined specifications and production-ready solutions. description:

Job Title

Data Product Delivery Manager

What does a successful Data Product Delivery Manager do at Fiserv?


Fiserv is uniquely positioned at the center of global commerce and financial services, powering the movement of money and information across an unmatched network of financial institutions, merchants, and consumers. With billions of transactions processed annually and deep integration across payment rails, banking systems, and merchant ecosystems, Fiserv has built a proprietary data advantage that no competitor can replicate—enabling insights across the full lifecycle of every transaction.

We are seeking a Data Product Delivery Manager within our Data Products Portfolio who will be responsible for building a scaled practice for product delivery. Accelerating revenue realization by ensuring strategic product initiatives, partner launches, and client commitments are delivered on time, within scope, and without disruption to growth objectives.


What you will do:

  • Own End-to-End Product Delivery & Client Commitments
    Oversee product deliveries in partnership with Technology to ensure client commitments are met, from initial Data Evaluation Agreement testing through implementation, onboarding and handoff to Business Development. Own SLA performance and delivery commitments through go-live and steady state, serving as the single point of accountability for delivery risks, escalations, and client testing and implementation questions.
  • Accelerate Evaluation-to-Contract Conversion
    Partner with clients and Product Solution Consultants to set test objectives, timelines and success criteria at the start of each Data Evaluation. Coordinate evaluation materials such as sample files, data dictionaries, methodology notes and FAQs, track evaluation-to-contract conversion and time-to-decision, and feed client objections, data gaps and feature requests to Product Management.
  • Lead Client Implementations from Contract to Go-Live
    Translate contract terms into clear delivery requirements, including data specifications, file formats, delivery cadence, permitted use and SLAs. Run each implementation with a defined project plan, task owners, milestones and status updates, define go-live readiness through client acceptance testing and sign-off, and partner with Finance so billing and revenue recognition begin at go-live.
  • Establish a Strong Foundation for Business Development Handoff
    Manage a defined post-launch support period with clear exit criteria and confirm early client adoption before handoff. Deliver a standard handoff package, including client contacts, use cases, configuration, SLA terms, open issues and expansion opportunities, so Business Development begins with a healthy account.
  • Ensure Reliable Steady-State Operations
    Manage delivery incidents such as data delays, restatements and quality issues, including client communication and root-cause analysis. Proactively notify clients of schema, methodology or panel changes, and deliver expansions for existing clients, such as new data sets or panels.
  • Build a Scalable Product Delivery Practice
    Create a standard delivery playbook of repeatable processes, templates and checklists across product types and delivery models, including direct clients and channel partners. Establish delivery KPIs and a portfolio-level risk view for leadership, forecast Technology and Analytics capacity against the sales pipeline, and identify opportunities to automate delivery and monitoring using DCS AI tools.

What you will need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • 6+ years of experience in product delivery, client implementation, technical program management or client onboarding, preferably with data products, data feeds or analytics solutions.
  • Prior relevant experience within issuing, banking and acquiring domains, including familiarity with transaction and payments data.
  • Proven experience managing client deliveries end to end, from evaluation and contracting through implementation, go-live and steady-state support.
  • Customer-centric mindset with experience translating client requirements and contract terms into delivery plans and technical specifications.
  • Strong understanding of agile practices, project management methods and SLA management, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent client deliveries and escalations.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interface directly with clients on a recurring basis.

What would be great to have:

  • High proficiency in data analysis (e.g., SQL, Excel) and the ability to use data to validate deliverables, troubleshoot data quality issues and support client testing questions.
  • Familiarity with data delivery methods such as cloud data sharing platforms, APIs, Agent to Agent.
  • Experience delivering data products to capital markets, marketing and commerce, or financial institution clients and channel partners.
  • Working knowledge of data privacy, data usage rights, and client security and vendor due diligence reviews.
  • Experience building delivery processes, playbooks and KPIs in a growing or newly formed team.
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster or similar project or delivery management certification.

$120,000.00 - $198,000.00

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

What does a successful Software Development Engineer (SDET) do?

We are modernising a large-scale payment acquiring platform, replacing a monolithic batch processing system with event-driven microservices on Cloud. The platform processes millions of transactions daily for institutions globally, covering the full acquiring lifecycle.

The modernisation spans five independent processing domains, each with its own engineering team. Migration is incremental, with legacy and new systems running in parallel during the transition.

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) you will design, build, and maintain the automated testing frameworks and quality engineering capabilities for the new platform. This role bridges software development and quality assurance — you will write production-grade test code, build testing infrastructure, and embed quality into every stage of the delivery pipeline. This will be roughly 20% strategy and test design, 80% hands-on — building frameworks, writing test code, integrating with CI/CD pipelines, analysing failures, and collaborating with development teams to shift quality left.

What you will do:

Test Framework Architecture & Development

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for API, event-driven, and end-to-end testing across the microservices platform.
  • Develop reusable test libraries, utilities, and abstractions that domain teams can consume to accelerate their own test development.
  • Implement contract testing (consumer-driven contracts) to validate API and event schema compatibility across independently deployed services.
  • Build test data management capabilities: synthetic data generation, seeding pipelines, and data virtualisation to enable isolated, repeatable test execution.

Functional & Integration Test Automation

  • Write and maintain automated test suites covering REST APIs, Kafka event flows, database operations, and cross-domain integration scenarios.
  • Implement BDD/TDD test patterns aligned with acceptance criteria, working closely with developers and product owners.
  • Design and automate complex end-to-end transaction flows across the acquiring lifecycle (capture, pricing, clearing, funding, disputes).
  • Validate schema evolution and backward compatibility across Avro schemas and Schema Registry.

Performance & Resilience Testing

  • Design and develop performance test scripts and scenarios using appropriate tooling (e.g. Gatling, k6, JMeter) targeting REST APIs, Kafka producers/consumers, and database operations.
  • Execute load, stress, soak, and spike tests across environments on AWS EKS, analysing results against defined SLIs/SLOs.
  • Test system behaviour under failure conditions: pod evictions, broker unavailability, database failover, network partitions, and resource exhaustion.
  • Validate back-pressure, retry, and circuit-breaker behaviour across the Kafka event pipeline under sustained load.

CI/CD Integration & Quality Gates

  • Integrate automated test suites into GitLab CI pipelines as quality gates — unit, integration, contract, and performance tests running at appropriate stages.
  • Build automated result analysis with clear pass/fail criteria, trend tracking, and regression detection.
  • Implement test parallelisation and optimisation strategies to keep pipeline feedback loops fast.
  • Contribute to the ArgoCD GitOps workflow to ensure test environments are consistently provisioned and reproducible.

Observability & Analysis

  • Analyse test failures and production incidents using Dynatrace (APM/tracing), Micrometer/Prometheus metrics, and Splunk logs to identify root causes.
  • Build quality dashboards and metrics reporting: test coverage, pass rates, flakiness trends, performance baselines, and defect escape rates.
  • Produce actionable analysis for engineering teams — not just results, but root-cause insights and recommendations.
  • Track performance trends across releases to detect regressions early and validate the impact of optimisation work.

Collaboration & Quality Advocacy

  • Embed quality earlier in the lifecycle: pair with engineers on TDD/BDD, contract tests, schema validation, and testability improvements.
  • Partner with SRE/Platform teams on non-functional requirements: security testing, compliance (PCI, PSD2), and environment management.
  • Participate in design reviews to advocate for testability, observability, and failure-mode coverage.
  • Coach domain teams on automation best practices, shift-left testing, and effective use of the shared test frameworks.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tooling to generate test scripts, analyse failures, and accelerate root-cause analysis.

What you will need to have:

  • Software development skills — strong programming ability in Java (or Kotlin/similar JVM language). You write production-quality code with proper design patterns, error handling, and maintainability.
  • Test automation frameworks — hands-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks (not just writing scripts within an existing framework). Experience with tools such as JUnit 5, REST Assured, Cucumber, or equivalent.
  • Distributed systems testing — experience testing microservices architectures with asynchronous messaging (Kafka or equivalent), understanding how to validate eventual consistency, event ordering, and end-to-end data flows.
  • API testing — deep experience with REST API testing including contract testing, schema validation, and integration testing across multiple services.
  • CI/CD integration — experience embedding automated tests into pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, or equivalent) with quality gates, parallel execution, and automated reporting.
  • Performance testing — practical experience with at least one load testing tool (Gatling, k6, JMeter, or equivalent) and ability to design realistic load scenarios and analyse results.
  • 6+ years in software quality engineering or test development roles with a strong development focus.

What is nice to have:

  • Financial services or payments — high-throughput transaction processing, batch processing pipelines, or similar volume-sensitive domains.
  • Kubernetes and cloud-native — experience with EKS/GKE/AKS, containerised test execution, and understanding of cloud-native deployment patterns.
  • Java/JVM performance — understanding of JVM profiling, garbage collection, thread pool management, and common performance anti-patterns.
  • Observability platforms — experience with APM tools (Dynatrace, Datadog), metrics platforms (Prometheus/Grafana), and log aggregation (Splunk, ELK).
  • Database testing — PostgreSQL or similar RDBMS, including data integrity validation, migration testing, and query performance analysis.
  • Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, Helm charts, or similar for provisioning test infrastructure on-demand.
  • Security testing — familiarity with SAST/DAST tools (Fortify, WebInspect, OWASP ZAP) and compliance automation.
  • AI-assisted testing — experience with AI copilots and tooling for test generation, maintenance, and failure analysis.
  • Contract testing — Pact or similar consumer-driven contract testing frameworks.

title: Product Manager Portioned Coffee
description:
About the role:

As Product Manager Portioned Coffee at Versuni Netherlands B.V., based in Amsterdam - The Rock, you will shape the strategic direction and lifecycle of our current and future coffee portfolio. You will translate different at-home routines and expectations into relevant propositions, while bringing new experiences to market across portioned coffee, grinding and filter coffee.

You will identify market opportunities, build business cases, and manage product roadmaps from concept to launch and beyond. Working closely with marketing, R&D, supply chain, sales, and selected OEM suppliers, you will expand our portfolio efficiently—including into emerging trends beyond coffee—while ensuring strong consumer relevance, quality, sustainability, and business viability.

The impact you’ll make:

In this role, you will strengthen Versuni’s position in coffee by ensuring our portfolio serves the main consumer routines and delivers compelling new experiences. Your choices will shape performance across markets, accelerate growth in grinding and filter coffee, and open adjacent opportunities beyond coffee.

By combining consumer insight with a pragmatic make-or-partner approach, you will shorten time to market and unlock proven OEM portfolios where they offer a competitive advantage. You will create relevant, high-quality propositions that drive consumer loyalty, profitable growth, and more sustainable product choices.

The skills and knowledge you’ll bring:

• Proven product management experience in coffee, small domestic appliances, or a related consumer goods sector, with the ability to shape portfolios around distinct consumer routines and expectations.
• Strong analytical skills to translate consumer insights, market trends, and financial metrics into portfolio choices and viable business cases.
• Excellent project management capabilities, managing complex initiatives across multiple departments.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills for teamwork and stakeholder engagement at all levels.
• Track record of launching and managing products across their lifecycle, ideally including portioned coffee, grinding or filter coffee, and adjacent beverage or appliance categories.
• Ability to spot emerging consumer trends and evaluate existing OEM supplier portfolios to bring differentiated propositions to market quickly and responsibly.
• Understanding ot sustainability practices relevant to product development and packaging within the coffee industry.
• Proficiency with relevant software tools, including product management and analytics platforms.


Additionally, your collaboration will empower teams to react swiftly to market trends and competitive
dynamics, ensuring our portioned coffee products remain at the forefront of the category, helping Versuni
to continue turning houses into homes around the world.

What we’ll give you in return:

• Internationally competitive base salary | benchmarked against global industry and market leaders
• Performance-based Annual Incentive Program | rewarding those who dare and achieve more
• Top of the market pension scheme | with higher-than-average company contributions
• Work from home, commuting and phone allowances | to support your daily commute, home office setup & business connectivity
• Hybrid working model | effectively combining working from the office & home, depending on team dynamics and personal needs
• Working from abroad | for up to 30 days per year, supporting our many international colleagues as well as travel enthusiasts
• Extensive holiday package | additional care and development days, extensive maternity / paternity leave & possibility to purchase days
• Bicycle Plan | possibility to select a company bicycle for daily commute along with accessories & insurance
• Health Insurance Discount | when signing up with our partner insurance
• Gym Membership Discount | to support your focus on health and wellbeing
• Product Discounts | on all Versuni products which are sold under the Philips brand and our other brands
• High growth environment | offering exciting learning and career development perspectives beyond your first role
• Inclusive working culture | we embrace our international community & diversity as competitive advantage

Ready to make an impact?

Are you ready to bring your expertise to a company that values innovation, sustainability, and excellence in product leadership? At Versuni, your work will directly influence how millions enjoy their coffee every day, turning ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences.

If you are passionate about driving product innovation in the coffee space, eager to learn and grow within a supportive global team, and committed to making a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply. Join us to contribute your talents to a purpose-driven company and help shape the future of home living.

Together, let's continue to create products that elevate daily routines and deliver joy to homes worldwide. We’re ready for you — are you ready for us?

title: Project Manager
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Project Manager

About your role:

Reporting to the Programme Director and/or Programme Manager, the role of Project Manager is to lead the planning, governance and delivery of complex client projects and initiatives in support of specified business outcomes, while managing resources across multiple areas, and potentially third parties, to achieve agreed cost, time and quality objectives.

The Project Manager is accountable for the overall progress, control and successful delivery of the project across the full lifecycle. The role provides leadership, structure and coordination across project workstreams, ensuring that scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues and dependencies are actively managed and aligned to programme objectives.

Working closely with clients, senior stakeholders, internal Fiserv teams and external partners, the Project Manager acts as a central point of leadership across delivery activities, ensuring that projects are delivered in line with business, operational and technical requirements, and that stakeholders remain aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

What you’ll do:

  • Defining the project brief and delivery approach in alignment with client and programme objectives.
  • Setting client expectations with respect to project deliverables, timelines, plans and governance.
  • Establishing an appropriate project governance structure in line with the Fiserv programme/project methodology and governance framework.
  • Supporting the client and sponsor in obtaining the necessary authorisations, approvals and sign-offs for the business case and key delivery decisions.
  • Documenting the overall project approach, including phasing strategy, scope boundaries, assumptions and delivery options where applicable.
  • Developing estimates for resources, costs and durations and, based on these, creating a high-level project schedule and requesting appropriate resources.
  • Facilitating the development of all elements of the project plan, including scope, schedule, budget, change management, issues, risks, procurement, testing, training, communications and transition to BAU.
  • Ensuring that all project impacts on business processes, operational readiness and business continuity are assessed and continually monitored throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinating cross-functional Fiserv teams, client stakeholders and third-party partners to ensure alignment on plans, deliverables, dependencies and milestones.
  • Acting as a primary point of coordination for the project and maintaining strong working relationships across stakeholders.

Execution & Controls

  • Managing and maintaining the overall project plan, governance, budget, work assignments, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies in accordance with established Fiserv governance.
  • Reporting project status, including schedule, cost, benefits, risks, issues, milestones and scope changes, to clients, sponsors and stakeholders on a regular basis.
  • Organising and facilitating governance forums to review project progress, manage escalations, support decisions and agree corrective or preventive actions.
  • Managing project risks and issues, ensuring that ownership is clearly assigned and that resolution activities are progressed in a timely manner.
  • Monitoring delivery progress across all workstreams and ensuring that deliverables are completed on time, within budget and to the required quality standards.
  • Ensuring that project team members and workstream leads are aligned on priorities, responsibilities, deliverables, reporting requirements and escalation paths.
  • Building and maintaining a cohesive cross-functional project team environment and fostering productive working relationships across Fiserv, client and third-party teams.
  • Ensuring the development, review and approval of all key project deliverables and governance outputs.
  • Refining resource, cost and duration estimates as the project progresses, ensuring that resource requirements for each phase are identified early enough to secure the required support.
  • Managing proposed changes in scope, schedule or budget with key stakeholders, clearly communicating impacts, trade-offs and recommended actions.
  • Scheduling, managing and participating in project reviews, quality reviews and key delivery checkpoints, and driving action plans to address issues arising.
  • Organising, leading and motivating a matrix team of Fiserv SMEs and, where applicable, third-party resources.
  • Maintaining an ongoing dialogue with PMO and programme leadership to ensure that defined project processes are followed and that issues are addressed in a timely and structured manner.
  • Ensuring a structured and fully supported transition to BAU, including appropriate handovers to service and support teams.
  • Providing leadership support during critical delivery milestones, including out-of-hours coverage where required.
  • Performing project administration, including status reporting, documentation management, financial tracking, action tracking and governance support.

Closeout & Transition

  • Obtaining approval from the sponsor and client that project acceptance criteria have been met.
  • Confirming that project objectives and agreed deliverables have been achieved.
  • Confirming that all outstanding project risks and issues have been accepted, transitioned or resolved appropriately.
  • Performing comparisons of estimated and actual costs and supporting financial closeout activities.
  • Facilitating the project evaluation and obtaining approval to close out the project, documented within an end-of-project report.
  • Performing project closeout activities and archiving project documentation. Where applicable, conducting a formal Lessons Learned session and publishing the results to all stakeholders.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • Significant proven experience in project management roles, preferably gained within the Financial Services industry, in the Cards and Payments sector (8+ years).
  • Strong command of MS Office products, especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint and MS Project.
  • Strong client-facing communication, stakeholder management and governance leadership skills.
  • Strong leadership presence, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams in a matrix environment.
  • Strong understanding of project lifecycles, governance, financial control and transition to BAU.
  • Ability to plan and monitor complex projects consisting of multiple workstreams and delivery endpoints.
  • Ability to build and maintain a strong network of contacts across the Fiserv organization, interfacing with multiple IT groups, business units and external stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with professional proficiency both in English and in Italian.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • PRINCE2 certification or equivalent project management certification preferred.
  • Experience in card and/or payment processing environments is preferred.
  • Proven experience managing complex, medium to large client-facing projects involving multiple workstreams, stakeholders and interdependent resources.
  • Experience managing full lifecycle projects, including planning, governance, financial control, execution oversight and transition to BAU.

description:
